en: In news reports, writers often abbreviate long names; for example, the World Health Organization becomes WHO.
zh: 在新聞報導中，記者常把長名稱縮寫，例如世界衛生組織就寫成 WHO。

en: All players must abide by the rules of the game, or the judge will ask them to leave.
zh: 所有選手都必須遵守比賽規則，否則裁判會請他們離場。

en: Taiwan's aboriginal peoples, who lived on the island long before others arrived, have rich traditions of song and dance.
zh: 台灣的原住民族早在其他人到來之前就住在這座島上，擁有豐富的歌舞傳統。

en: Fish and birds abound in the wet areas near the river; visitors can see thousands of them every winter.
zh: 河邊的濕地有大量的魚和鳥，遊客每年冬天都能看到成千上萬隻。

en: Some modern painters prefer abstraction, using only shapes and colors instead of showing real people or objects.
zh: 有些現代畫家偏好抽象，只用形狀和色彩，而不畫出真實的人或物體。

en: Thanks to heavy rain this spring, farmers enjoyed an abundance of fruit and had more than they could sell.
zh: 多虧今年春天雨量充沛，農民的水果大豐收，多到賣不完。

en: After high school, Lisa hopes to study at a famous music academy where top musicians train young students.
zh: 高中畢業後，Lisa 希望到一所由頂尖音樂家培訓年輕學生的知名音樂學院就讀。

en: A simple scarf is a useful fashion accessory that can make a plain dress look more interesting.
zh: 一條簡單的圍巾就是實用的時尚配件，能讓素色洋裝看起來更有變化。

en: Her first novel won wide acclaim, and critics around the world praised its beautiful and honest writing.
zh: 她的第一本小說廣受好評，世界各地的評論家都稱讚其文筆優美而真誠。

en: In accordance with school rules, all students must turn off their phones during exams.
zh: 依照校規，所有學生在考試期間都必須關掉手機。

en: The weather report says it will be cold tomorrow, so you should dress accordingly and bring a warm coat.
zh: 氣象報告說明天會很冷，所以你應該相應地穿著，並帶件保暖的外套。

en: Leaders should be held accountable for their decisions and explain to the public why they made them.
zh: 領導者應該為自己的決定負責，並向大眾說明做出這些決定的原因。

en: If you do not clean your room regularly, dust will accumulate quickly under the bed and on the shelves.
zh: 如果你不定期打掃房間，灰塵很快就會在床底下和架子上累積。

en: The slow accumulation of plastic waste in the ocean is a serious threat to sea animals.
zh: 塑膠垃圾在海洋中慢慢累積，對海洋動物構成嚴重威脅。

en: Mia denied the accusation that she had copied her classmate's homework, saying she had worked on it alone.
zh: Mia 否認抄襲同學作業的指控，說那是她自己一個人完成的。

en: It took me several weeks to accustom myself to getting up at six for my new school.
zh: 為了新學校，我花了好幾個星期才讓自己習慣六點起床。

en: Many teenagers suffer from acne, small red spots on the face that often appear during the teenage years.
zh: 許多青少年為青春痘所苦，那是青春期常出現在臉上的紅色小斑點。

en: The farm covers about fifty acres, which is roughly the size of thirty soccer fields.
zh: 這座農場占地約五十英畝，大約是三十座足球場的大小。

en: Thick fur is an important adaptation that helps bears in the far north survive the extreme cold.
zh: 厚厚的毛皮是一種重要的適應特徵，幫助生活在極北地區的熊撐過嚴寒。

en: Experts warn that phone addiction can harm teenagers' sleep, as many cannot stop checking their screens at night.
zh: 專家警告，手機成癮會影響青少年的睡眠，因為許多人晚上停不下來一直看螢幕。

en: The local government administers the national park, managing its trails and protecting its wildlife.
zh: 地方政府管理這座國家公園，負責維護步道並保護園內的野生動物。

en: In history class, we learned about Zheng He, a Chinese admiral who commanded hundreds of ships on long voyages.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們認識了鄭和，一位率領數百艘船遠航的中國海軍將領。

en: Adolescence, the period between childhood and becoming an adult, is a time of rapid physical and emotional change.
zh: 青春期是介於童年與成年之間的階段，是身體和情緒快速變化的時期。

en: The school formed an advisory group of parents and teachers to give suggestions on the new lunch menu.
zh: 學校成立了一個由家長和老師組成的諮詢小組，針對新的午餐菜單提供建議。

en: Many visitors admire the old temple for its aesthetic value, especially the beauty of its carved roof.
zh: 許多遊客欣賞這座古廟的美學價值，尤其是它雕刻精美的屋頂。

en: Our cat is very affectionate; she loves to sit on my lap and rub her head against my hand.
zh: 我們的貓非常親人，她喜歡坐在我的腿上，用頭磨蹭我的手。

en: This hospital is an affiliate of the national university, so many medical students train there.
zh: 這家醫院是國立大學的附屬機構，所以許多醫學系學生在那裡實習。

en: A new study affirms what many parents already believed: regular exercise helps children focus better in class.
zh: 一項新研究證實了許多家長早就相信的事：規律運動能幫助孩子上課更專心。

en: Keep cookies in an airtight container so that air cannot get in and make them soft.
zh: 把餅乾放在密封的容器裡，空氣才不會跑進去讓餅乾變軟。

en: Smoke can harm the airways, making it hard for people with weak lungs to breathe.
zh: 煙霧會傷害呼吸道，讓肺部較弱的人呼吸困難。

en: In algebra, we use letters such as x and y to stand for numbers that we do not know yet.
zh: 在代數中，我們用 x 和 y 等字母來代表還不知道的數字。

en: Constantly talking about yourself may alienate your friends and make them want to spend less time with you.
zh: 一直談論自己可能會疏遠朋友，讓他們不想花太多時間和你相處。

en: Before printing, make sure the text and pictures are properly aligned with the edges of the page.
zh: 列印之前，要確定文字和圖片都和頁面邊緣對齊。

en: A news report alleges that the factory has been dumping waste into the river, but the company denies it.
zh: 一篇新聞報導聲稱那家工廠一直把廢棄物倒進河裡，但公司否認此事。

en: Alligators live mainly in rivers and wet, muddy areas in the southern United States and in eastern China.
zh: 短吻鱷主要生活在美國南部和中國東部的河流與潮濕泥濘地區。

en: At high altitudes, the air contains less oxygen, so people who climb mountains often feel tired and short of breath.
zh: 在高海拔地區，空氣中的氧氣較少，所以登山的人常感到疲倦又喘不過氣。

en: Aluminum is a light metal that is widely used to make soda cans and airplane parts.
zh: 鋁是一種輕金屬，廣泛用來製造汽水罐和飛機零件。

en: To avoid ambiguity, the teacher explained the question again so that everyone understood exactly what it meant.
zh: 為了避免模稜兩可，老師把題目再解釋一次，讓每個人都確切了解它的意思。

en: Amid the noise of the busy market, an old man sat quietly reading his newspaper.
zh: 在熱鬧市場的喧鬧聲中，一位老人安靜地坐著看報紙。

en: Speakers are used to amplify the singer's voice so that people in the back rows can hear clearly.
zh: 擴音喇叭被用來放大歌手的聲音，讓坐在後排的人也能聽得清楚。

en: Our biology teacher used an analogy, comparing the heart to a pump that pushes blood around the body.
zh: 我們的生物老師用了一個類比，把心臟比作將血液輸送到全身的幫浦。

en: Solving science problems requires strong analytical skills, such as breaking a question into smaller parts.
zh: 解決科學問題需要很強的分析能力，例如把一個問題拆成幾個較小的部分。

en: When the storm came, the sailors dropped the ship's anchor near the island to keep it from drifting away.
zh: 暴風雨來襲時，水手們在島附近拋下船錨，以免船被沖走。

en: Her lively stories animated the class, and even the quiet students began to share their ideas.
zh: 她生動的故事讓全班活絡起來，連安靜的學生都開始分享想法。

en: To her annoyance, the bus left just as Amy reached the stop, so she had to wait twenty minutes.
zh: 令 Amy 惱火的是，她剛走到站牌公車就開走了，害她得再等二十分鐘。

en: Before the game began, everyone stood up and sang the national anthem together.
zh: 比賽開始前，所有人起立一起唱國歌。

en: Antibiotics can kill bacteria, but they do not work against viruses such as those that cause the common cold.
zh: 抗生素能殺死細菌，但對病毒無效，例如引起一般感冒的病毒。

en: The crowd waited in excited anticipation for the famous singer to appear on the stage.
zh: 群眾滿懷興奮的期待，等著那位知名歌手登台。

en: An antonym is a word with the opposite meaning; for example, "tall" is the antonym of "short."
zh: 反義詞是意思相反的字，例如 tall（高）是 short（矮）的反義詞。

en: When the performance ended, the audience stood up to applaud the dancers for several minutes.
zh: 表演結束時，觀眾起立為舞者鼓掌了好幾分鐘。

en: This discount is applicable only to students, so you must show your student card to get it.
zh: 這個折扣只適用於學生，所以你必須出示學生證才能享有。

en: In the past, a young apprentice would work under a skilled carpenter for years to learn the trade.
zh: 過去，年輕的學徒會跟著技術純熟的木匠工作好幾年來學這門手藝。

en: Our guide gave us the approximate time of arrival: around three hours, depending on traffic.
zh: 導遊告訴我們大約的抵達時間：視交通狀況而定，約三小時左右。

en: Archaeology is the study of human history through objects that people left behind, such as tools and pottery.
zh: 考古學是透過人類留下的物品（例如工具和陶器）來研究人類歷史的學問。

en: This museum keeps old letters and photographs in its archive, where researchers can study them.
zh: 這座博物館把舊信件和照片保存在檔案庫裡，供研究人員研究。

en: Young children learn basic arithmetic, such as adding and subtracting, before they move on to harder math.
zh: 小孩子在學更難的數學之前，會先學加法、減法等基本算術。

en: The hot-air balloon slowly ascended into the sky as the crowd below waved goodbye.
zh: 熱氣球緩緩升上天空，下方的群眾揮手道別。

en: Many students aspire to become doctors, hoping to help sick people and make a difference in society.
zh: 許多學生立志成為醫生，希望幫助病人並為社會帶來改變。

en: In history class, we learned that President Abraham Lincoln was assassinated in 1865, shortly after the Civil War ended.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到林肯總統在 1865 年南北戰爭結束後不久遭到暗殺。

en: People with asthma may have trouble breathing, especially when the air is polluted or very cold.
zh: 患有氣喘的人可能會呼吸困難，尤其是在空氣污染或非常寒冷的時候。

en: Without a map, the group went astray while hiking and ended up far from the main trail.
zh: 沒有地圖，這群人在健行時迷了路，最後離主要步道很遠。

en: Neil Armstrong, an American astronaut, became the first person to walk on the moon in 1969.
zh: 美國太空人阿姆斯壯在 1969 年成為第一個在月球上行走的人。

en: Using a powerful telescope, the astronomer discovered a small planet that no one had ever seen before.
zh: 這位天文學家用一具高倍望遠鏡，發現了一顆從來沒有人見過的小行星。

en: Galileo made important contributions to astronomy when he used a telescope to observe the moons of Jupiter.
zh: 伽利略用望遠鏡觀察木星的衛星，對天文學做出重要貢獻。

en: After years of hard work, she finally attained her goal of becoming a professional violin player.
zh: 經過多年努力，她終於達成成為職業小提琴手的目標。

en: On the plane, a flight attendant politely asked the passengers to fasten their seat belts before landing.
zh: 在飛機上，一位空服員有禮貌地請乘客在降落前繫好安全帶。

en: Every year, an outside company conducts an audit to check whether the charity has used its money properly.
zh: 每年都有外部公司進行稽核，檢查這個慈善團體是否妥善運用經費。

en: Our graduation ceremony will be held in the school auditorium, which can seat over a thousand people.
zh: 我們的畢業典禮將在學校禮堂舉行，那裡可以容納一千多人。

en: By acting quickly, the pilot averted a crash and landed the plane safely in a field.
zh: 機長反應迅速，避免了一場墜機事故，讓飛機安全降落在田野上。

en: In 1903, the Wright brothers made the first powered flight, marking the start of modern aviation.
zh: 1903 年，萊特兄弟完成了第一次動力飛行，象徵現代航空的開端。

en: The view from the top of the mountain was awesome; we could see the whole city and the sea.
zh: 山頂的景色令人驚嘆，我們可以看到整座城市和大海。

en: Let's rest awhile under this tree before we continue walking up the hill.
zh: 我們先在這棵樹下休息一會兒，再繼續往山上走吧。

en: After four years of study, Amy earned a bachelor's degree in biology from a university in Taipei.
zh: 經過四年的學習，Amy 取得了台北一所大學的生物學士學位。

en: Small family farms are the backbone of the local economy, providing jobs and food for the whole town.
zh: 小型家庭農場是當地經濟的骨幹，為全鎮提供工作機會和食物。

en: Every visitor must wear a name badge so that the security guards can identify them easily.
zh: 每位訪客都必須佩戴名牌徽章，讓警衛能輕易辨識身分。

en: To celebrate the festival, the hotel held a grand banquet with more than twenty dishes for its guests.
zh: 為了慶祝節日，飯店為賓客舉辦了一場有二十多道菜的盛大宴會。

en: Ancient Romans called people outside their empire barbarians, believing that they were wild and lacked culture.
zh: 古羅馬人把帝國以外的人稱為野蠻人，認為他們粗野又沒有文化。

en: Tom plays the bass in the school band, providing the deep, low sounds that support the melody.
zh: Tom 在學校樂團中彈貝斯，負責撐起旋律的深沉低音。

en: To make pancakes, mix flour, eggs, and milk into a smooth batter, then pour it into a hot pan.
zh: 做鬆餅時，把麵粉、蛋和牛奶拌成滑順的麵糊，再倒進熱鍋裡。

en: Volunteers planted flowers along the streets to beautify the neighborhood and make it more pleasant to live in.
zh: 志工們沿著街道種花，美化社區，讓這裡住起來更舒適。

en: The microwave gave a loud beep to let us know that the food was ready.
zh: 微波爐發出響亮的嗶嗶聲，告訴我們食物熱好了。

en: If you plan to visit the museum on a weekend, you should buy tickets beforehand to avoid long lines.
zh: 如果你打算週末去博物館，應該事先買票，以免大排長龍。

en: Water is the healthiest beverage, while drinks with lots of sugar, like soda, can lead to weight gain.
zh: 水是最健康的飲料，而汽水之類含大量糖分的飲料可能會導致體重增加。

en: After long talks, the two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement that benefits farmers on both sides.
zh: 經過長期協商，兩國簽署了一項雙邊貿易協定，讓雙方的農民都受惠。

en: It took hours to put out the blaze that destroyed the old wooden factory near the port.
zh: 花了好幾個小時才撲滅那場燒毀港口附近老舊木造工廠的大火。

en: Bleach can remove stains and kill germs, but it should never be mixed with other cleaning products.
zh: 漂白劑可以去除污漬、殺死細菌，但絕對不能和其他清潔用品混用。

en: In the painting, a young girl has long blond hair that shines like gold in the sun.
zh: 畫中的小女孩有一頭長長的金髮，在陽光下像黃金般閃耀。

en: An ink blot on the final page ruined Lisa's neat report, so she had to copy it again.
zh: 最後一頁上的墨水污漬毀了 Lisa 整齊的報告，所以她只好重抄一遍。

en: This knife is too blunt to cut the bread; we need a sharper one.
zh: 這把刀太鈍了，切不動麵包，我們需要一把更利的。

en: Exercise is good for both bodily and mental health, helping us stay strong and feel happier.
zh: 運動對身體和心理健康都有益，幫助我們保持強壯、心情更愉快。

en: Each student received a small booklet with information about the school's rules and activities.
zh: 每個學生都拿到一本小冊子，裡面有關於校規和學校活動的資訊。

en: The child felt safe in the bosom of her loving family, surrounded by warmth and care.
zh: 在充滿愛的家庭懷抱中，這個孩子感到安心，被溫暖和關懷所包圍。

en: Tall trees line both sides of the wide boulevard, giving shade to people walking along it.
zh: 高大的樹木排列在寬闊林蔭大道的兩旁，為路過的行人遮蔭。

en: Boxing helps build strength and speed, so some people take boxing classes just to keep fit.
zh: 拳擊有助於鍛鍊力量和速度，所以有些人上拳擊課只是為了保持身材。

en: Many customers decided to boycott the store, refusing to shop there after it was found selling dangerous toys.
zh: 那家店被發現販售危險玩具後，許多顧客決定抵制，拒絕再去購物。

en: After hurting her knee, Mia had to wear a brace to support it while it healed.
zh: 膝蓋受傷後，Mia 必須戴護具支撐，直到傷勢痊癒。

en: In the early 1900s, the modern brassiere began replacing tight, stiff underwear, letting women move more freely.
zh: 二十世紀初，現代胸罩開始取代緊身又僵硬的內衣，讓女性活動更自在。

en: We were surprised by the breadth of her knowledge, as she could discuss art, science, and history easily.
zh: 她知識的廣度令我們驚訝，藝術、科學和歷史她都能侃侃而談。

en: A breakdown of the train's engine left hundreds of passengers waiting at the station for hours.
zh: 火車引擎故障，讓數百名乘客在車站等了好幾個小時。

en: Over millions of years, the breakup of one giant area of land slowly formed the continents we see today.
zh: 經過數百萬年，一整塊巨大陸地的分裂慢慢形成了今日所見的各大洲。

en: After accepting a bribe from a company, the official lost his job and faced a trial in court.
zh: 那名官員收受一家公司的賄賂後丟了工作，還得出庭受審。

en: Many species are on the brink of disappearing forever because their natural homes are being destroyed.
zh: 許多物種因為自然棲地遭到破壞，正瀕臨永遠消失的邊緣。

en: Traveling to other countries can broaden your mind and help you understand different cultures.
zh: 到其他國家旅行可以開闊你的心胸，幫助你了解不同的文化。

en: At the travel agency, we picked up a colorful brochure describing tours to Japan and Korea.
zh: 在旅行社，我們拿了一本色彩繽紛的手冊，上面介紹日本和韓國的旅遊行程。

en: Instead of frying the fish in oil, Mom decided to broil it in the oven for a healthier meal.
zh: 媽媽決定不用油煎魚，而是放進烤箱烤，讓這餐更健康。

en: A small brook runs through the forest, and its clear water is cool even in summer.
zh: 一條小溪流過森林，清澈的溪水即使在夏天也很清涼。

en: When I had a cold, my grandmother made me a bowl of warm chicken broth with vegetables.
zh: 我感冒時，奶奶為我煮了一碗加了蔬菜的熱雞湯。

en: Playing on the same team for years created a strong sense of brotherhood among the young men.
zh: 多年來在同一支隊伍打球，讓這些年輕人培養出深厚的手足情誼。

en: My old computer was so bulky that it took up almost half of my desk.
zh: 我的舊電腦體積龐大，幾乎占了我書桌的一半。

en: Citizens complained that the bureaucrats cared more about forms and rules than about solving real problems.
zh: 市民抱怨那些官僚只在乎表格和規定，而不是解決真正的問題。

en: The new road will bypass the town center, so trucks no longer have to drive through the busy streets.
zh: 新道路將繞過市中心，卡車就不必再穿越繁忙的街道。

en: Coffee and tea contain caffeine, which can keep you awake if you drink them late at night.
zh: 咖啡和茶含有咖啡因，如果深夜喝，可能會讓你睡不著。

en: Students may use a calculator during the math test, but they must show all their steps.
zh: 學生在數學考試時可以使用計算機，但必須寫出所有計算步驟。

en: Chinese calligraphy is the art of writing beautiful characters with a brush and ink.
zh: 中國書法是用毛筆和墨寫出優美字體的藝術。

en: In the play, the king wore a long red cape over his shoulders that flowed behind him as he walked.
zh: 在戲劇中，國王肩上披著一件紅色長披肩，走路時在身後飄動。

en: Please take one capsule of this medicine with a glass of water after every meal.
zh: 請在每餐飯後配一杯水服用一顆這種藥的膠囊。

en: Each photo in the magazine has a short caption explaining who is in the picture and where it was taken.
zh: 雜誌裡的每張照片都有一段簡短的說明文字，解釋照片中的人是誰以及拍攝地點。

en: Held captive in a small cage for years, the parrot was finally set free in the forest.
zh: 這隻鸚鵡被關在小籠子裡好幾年，終於被放回森林重獲自由。

en: Some animals that are raised in captivity, such as in zoos, have trouble surviving in the wild.
zh: 有些在圈養環境中長大的動物，例如動物園裡的動物，很難在野外生存。

en: We used old cardboard boxes to build a model castle for our art project.
zh: 我們用舊的硬紙板箱為美術作業做了一座城堡模型。

en: Safety is the cardinal rule in the science lab, so never touch chemicals without the teacher's permission.
zh: 安全是科學實驗室最主要的規則，所以沒有老師允許絕對不可碰觸化學藥品。

en: Children spend carefree summer days playing outside, without worrying about homework or exams.
zh: 孩子們無憂無慮地度過夏日，在戶外玩耍，不用擔心功課或考試。

en: An old caretaker looks after the empty house, cleaning the rooms and checking the garden every morning.
zh: 一位年長的管理員負責照看這棟空屋，每天早上打掃房間並巡視花園。

en: Please put the empty milk carton in the recycling bin after you finish your breakfast.
zh: 吃完早餐後，請把空的牛奶紙盒放進資源回收桶。

en: At the supermarket, the cashier counted my money carefully and gave me my change and receipt.
zh: 在超市，收銀員仔細點算我的錢，然後把找零和收據交給我。

en: Because buildings were built to be strong, the earthquake caused few casualties, and only a few people were slightly hurt.
zh: 因為建築物蓋得很堅固，這場地震造成的傷亡很少，只有少數人受輕傷。

en: Scientists warn that rising sea levels could be a catastrophe for small islands and cities near the coast.
zh: 科學家警告，海平面上升可能對小島和沿海城市造成大災難。

en: A local restaurant will cater the graduation party, providing food and drinks for two hundred guests.
zh: 一家當地餐廳將為畢業派對提供外燴，替兩百位賓客準備餐點和飲料。

en: A caterpillar eats leaves for weeks before turning into a beautiful butterfly.
zh: 毛毛蟲會吃好幾個星期的葉子，然後才變成美麗的蝴蝶。

en: Eating too much candy without brushing your teeth can cause a cavity, a small hole in the tooth.
zh: 吃太多糖果又不刷牙可能會造成蛀牙，也就是牙齒上的小洞。

en: Celery is a green vegetable with long, crunchy stems that is often eaten raw in salads.
zh: 芹菜是一種有著長而爽脆莖部的綠色蔬菜，常生吃拌在沙拉裡。

en: Scientists study cellular changes to understand how cancer begins inside the body's cells.
zh: 科學家研究細胞層面的變化，以了解癌症如何在體內細胞中產生。

en: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius and boils at 100 degrees at sea level.
zh: 在海平面高度，水在攝氏零度結冰，在攝氏一百度沸騰。

en: Workers mixed cement, sand, and water to make a strong base for the new bridge.
zh: 工人把水泥、沙和水混合在一起，為新橋打造堅固的基礎。

en: The government carries out a census every ten years to count how many people live in the country.
zh: 政府每十年進行一次人口普查，統計國內有多少人口。

en: At the museum, we saw ceramic bowls and vases that were made by hand more than five hundred years ago.
zh: 在博物館裡，我們看到五百多年前手工製作的陶瓷碗和花瓶。

en: This document certifies that Amy has completed the first aid course and can help in emergencies.
zh: 這份文件證明 Amy 已完成急救課程，能在緊急情況下提供協助。

en: As chairperson of the student council, Lisa leads every meeting and makes sure everyone gets to speak.
zh: 身為學生會主席，Lisa 主持每一次會議，並確保每個人都有發言機會。

en: Champagne, a type of sparkling wine, takes its name from the area in France where it is made.
zh: 香檳是一種氣泡酒，名稱來自它在法國的產地。

en: Thousands of fans chanted the team's name loudly as the players walked onto the field.
zh: 球員走進場地時，成千上萬的球迷大聲反覆呼喊球隊的名字。

en: Lisa's aunt runs a charitable organization that provides free meals for poor families in the city.
zh: Lisa 的阿姨經營一個慈善機構，為市內的貧困家庭提供免費餐點。

en: Doctors suggest getting a medical checkup once a year to find health problems early.
zh: 醫生建議每年做一次健康檢查，以便及早發現健康問題。

en: Marie Curie was a famous chemist and physicist who won two Nobel Prizes in different fields.
zh: 居禮夫人是著名的化學家和物理學家，曾在不同領域獲得兩座諾貝爾獎。

en: In winter, the smell of roasted chestnuts fills the night markets in Taipei.
zh: 冬天時，台北的夜市裡瀰漫著烤栗子的香味。

en: This soup is very spicy because the cook added several red chili peppers.
zh: 這道湯非常辣，因為廚師加了好幾根紅辣椒。

en: Jane Goodall discovered that chimpanzees use sticks as tools to catch insects to eat.
zh: 珍古德發現黑猩猩會把樹枝當作工具來捕捉昆蟲吃。

en: Every morning, I wake up to the cheerful chirp of birds outside my window.
zh: 每天早上，我都在窗外鳥兒愉快的啁啾聲中醒來。

en: Eating too much fried food can raise your cholesterol level and increase the risk of heart disease.
zh: 吃太多油炸食物會提高膽固醇，並增加罹患心臟病的風險。

en: Like cigarettes, cigars contain harmful chemicals that can cause cancer and other serious diseases.
zh: 和香菸一樣，雪茄也含有可能導致癌症和其他重大疾病的有害化學物質。

en: Many ancient writers believed that education and laws could civilize people and make society more peaceful.
zh: 許多古代的作家相信，教育和法律能使人變得文明，讓社會更加和平。

en: We dug for clams on the beach and cooked them in a soup with garlic and ginger.
zh: 我們在海灘上挖蛤蜊，然後加大蒜和薑煮成湯。

en: The little girl clasped her mother's hand tightly as they crossed the busy street.
zh: 過繁忙的馬路時，小女孩緊緊握住媽媽的手。

en: During the clearance sale, all winter clothes were sold at half price to make room for new items.
zh: 清倉特賣期間，所有冬季衣物都半價出售，好騰出空間放新商品。

en: In the climax of the story, the hero finally faces his greatest fear on the top of the mountain.
zh: 在故事的高潮中，主角終於在山頂面對他最大的恐懼。

en: Turn the lid clockwise to close the bottle, and turn it the other way to open it.
zh: 把蓋子順時針轉就能關緊瓶子，往反方向轉就能打開。

en: In 1996, scientists created Dolly the sheep, the first mammal cloned from an adult cell.
zh: 1996 年，科學家創造出桃莉羊，牠是第一隻由成體細胞複製出來的哺乳動物。

en: After the closure of the only factory in town, hundreds of workers had to look for new jobs.
zh: 鎮上唯一的工廠關閉後，數百名工人必須另找新工作。

en: A coalition of environmental groups worked together to protect the forest from being cut down.
zh: 一個由環保團體組成的聯盟合作保護這片森林，避免它遭到砍伐。

en: Taiwan's eastern coastline is famous for its high cliffs and beautiful views of the Pacific Ocean.
zh: 台灣東部海岸線以高聳的懸崖和美麗的太平洋景色聞名。

en: Many scientists believe that the collision of a huge space rock with Earth caused the dinosaurs to die out.
zh: 許多科學家相信，一顆巨大太空岩石與地球的碰撞導致恐龍滅絕。

en: Colloquial expressions are fine in casual conversation, but you should avoid them in formal writing.
zh: 口語的說法在輕鬆的對話中沒問題，但在正式寫作中應該避免使用。

en: Halley's Comet can be seen from Earth about every 76 years; it last appeared in 1986.
zh: 哈雷彗星大約每 76 年可從地球上看見一次，上一次出現是在 1986 年。

en: Mobile phones, once rare and expensive, are now commonplace, and almost every student carries one.
zh: 手機曾經稀少又昂貴，現在卻很普遍，幾乎每個學生都帶著一支。

en: Canada and Australia belong to the Commonwealth, a group of nations, most of which were once British colonies.
zh: 加拿大和澳洲都是大英國協的成員，國協中的國家大多曾是英國的殖民地。

en: Lisa is very communicative; she enjoys talking with new people and sharing her ideas in class.
zh: Lisa 很健談，她喜歡和新朋友聊天，也喜歡在課堂上分享想法。

en: This comparative study examines how teenagers in Taiwan and Japan spend their free time.
zh: 這項比較研究探討台灣和日本的青少年如何運用空閒時間。

en: Before phones had maps, people hiking in the mountains relied on a compass to find north.
zh: 在手機有地圖功能之前，在山上健行的人依靠指南針找出北方。

en: Our teacher compiled a list of useful words from past exams to help us prepare.
zh: 老師從歷屆考題中編纂了一份實用單字表，幫助我們準備考試。

en: A glass of fresh juice nicely complements a healthy breakfast of eggs and toast.
zh: 一杯新鮮果汁和由蛋與吐司組成的健康早餐搭配得恰到好處。

en: Getting enough sleep and drinking plenty of water can help keep your complexion clear and healthy.
zh: 睡眠充足、多喝水有助於讓你的膚色保持透亮健康。

en: This book offers a comprehensive guide to Taiwan's birds, covering every kind found on the island.
zh: 這本書是一份全面的台灣鳥類指南，涵蓋島上可見的每一種鳥。

en: Scientists use powerful computers to compute the paths of satellites as they travel around Earth.
zh: 科學家使用高效能電腦來計算人造衛星繞行地球的軌道。

en: Many libraries have computerized their records, so readers can search for books online in seconds.
zh: 許多圖書館已將館藏紀錄電腦化，讀者幾秒鐘內就能在線上搜尋書籍。

en: After fifty years, the old soldiers met again and greeted their comrades with warm smiles.
zh: 五十年後，老兵們再次相聚，用溫暖的笑容問候昔日的夥伴。

en: After long talks, both sides made concessions, and the workers agreed to a smaller pay raise.
zh: 經過長時間協商，雙方都做出讓步，工人同意接受較少的加薪幅度。

en: Your essay should be concise; use short, clear sentences and avoid extra words.
zh: 你的文章應該簡潔，使用簡短清楚的句子，避免多餘的字詞。

en: We were asked to condense the long article into a short summary of one hundred words.
zh: 我們被要求把那篇長文濃縮成一百字的簡短摘要。

en: Switzerland began as a confederation, a loose union of small states that agreed to help one another.
zh: 瑞士最初是一個邦聯，也就是由一些小邦組成、彼此約定互助的鬆散聯盟。

en: A local congressman visited our school to talk with students about how laws are made.
zh: 一位地方選出的國會議員來我們學校，和學生談論法律是如何制定的。

en: In the 1500s, the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire changed the history of Mexico forever.
zh: 十六世紀時，西班牙征服阿茲特克帝國，永遠改變了墨西哥的歷史。

en: Amy is a conscientious student who always finishes her homework carefully and on time.
zh: Amy 是個認真盡責的學生，總是仔細又準時地完成作業。

en: To conserve water, turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
zh: 為了節約用水，刷牙時要關掉水龍頭。

en: Although our team lost the final, it was some consolation that we had played our best.
zh: 雖然我們隊輸了決賽，但我們已經盡力了，這多少是一種安慰。

en: When Lisa failed the test, her friends tried to console her by saying she would do better next time.
zh: Lisa 考試不及格時，朋友們試著安慰她，說她下次會考得更好。

en: Most English words mix consonants like b, c, and d with the letters a, e, i, o, and u.
zh: 大多數英文單字都由 b、c、d 等子音和 a、e、i、o、u 等字母組合而成。

en: Despite clear evidence, some people still believe the conspiracy theory that the moon landing was fake.
zh: 儘管證據明確，有些人仍相信登月是造假的陰謀論。

en: A major point of contention in the meeting was whether students should be allowed to use phones in class.
zh: 會議中的一大爭論點是學生是否應該被允許在課堂上使用手機。

en: Each contestant on the singing show had three minutes to impress the judges.
zh: 歌唱節目中的每位參賽者都有三分鐘的時間打動評審。

en: Keeping the same teacher for three years gives students a sense of continuity and stability.
zh: 三年都由同一位老師帶班，能讓學生感受到連續性和穩定感。

en: Their stories contradict each other: Tom says he was at home, but Ben saw him at the mall.
zh: 他們的說法互相矛盾：Tom 說他當時在家，但 Ben 卻在購物中心看到他。

en: Our principal convened a meeting of all teachers to discuss the new exam schedule.
zh: 校長召集全體老師開會，討論新的考試時程。

en: Coral provides a home for thousands of kinds of sea creatures, but rising ocean temperatures are killing it.
zh: 珊瑚為數千種海洋生物提供棲身之所，但海水溫度上升正讓珊瑚死亡。

en: In 1991, two people hiking in the Alps found the corpse of a man who lived over 5,000 years ago.
zh: 1991 年，兩名在阿爾卑斯山健行的人發現一具屍體，此人生活在五千多年前。

en: Visitors can read the writer's personal correspondence, including hundreds of letters she sent to her family.
zh: 參觀者可以閱讀這位作家的私人通信，包括她寄給家人的數百封信。

en: Cosmetic products such as lipstick and face cream should be tested for safety before they are sold.
zh: 口紅、面霜等化妝用品在販售前都應該經過安全測試。

en: Many young people now prefer cosmetics made from natural materials rather than harsh chemicals.
zh: 現在許多年輕人偏好用天然原料製成的化妝品，而非刺激性的化學物質。

en: Our principal met her counterpart from a Japanese school to plan an exchange program for students.
zh: 我們的校長和一所日本學校的校長會面，規劃學生交流計畫。

en: With this coupon, you can get a free drink when you buy any sandwich.
zh: 憑這張優惠券，購買任何三明治都可以免費獲得一杯飲料。

en: Traditional Chinese houses were often built around a courtyard, an open space where families could gather.
zh: 傳統的中式房屋常圍繞著庭院而建，庭院是家人可以聚在一起的開放空間。

en: In the story, the cowardly lion runs away whenever he hears a loud noise.
zh: 在故事裡，那隻膽小的獅子一聽到巨響就逃跑。

en: The small coffee shop was warm and cozy, with soft chairs and a fire burning in the corner.
zh: 這間小咖啡店溫暖又舒適，有柔軟的椅子，角落裡還燒著爐火。

en: City police announced a crackdown on drivers who send text messages or use phones while driving.
zh: 市警局宣布將嚴厲取締開車時傳簡訊或使用手機的駕駛人。

en: I usually eat a few crackers with cheese as a quick snack after school.
zh: 放學後，我通常會吃幾片餅乾配起司當作簡單的點心。

en: Instead of cramming the night before the exam, it's better to review a little every day.
zh: 與其在考試前一晚死記硬背，不如每天複習一點。

en: After running for an hour, Ben got a painful cramp in his leg and had to stop.
zh: 跑了一個小時後，Ben 的腿痛苦地抽筋，只好停下來。

en: About 50,000 years ago, a rock from space hit Arizona and left a huge crater over a kilometer wide.
zh: 大約五萬年前，一塊來自太空的岩石撞擊亞利桑那州，留下一個寬超過一公里的巨大坑洞。

en: Before using information from the Internet, check whether it comes from a credible source.
zh: 在使用網路上的資訊之前，要先確認它是否來自可信的來源。

en: Crocodiles spend much of the day lying in the sun, but they are fast hunters in the water.
zh: 鱷魚白天大部分時間都躺著曬太陽，但在水中卻是動作迅速的獵食者。

en: Children should cross the street only at a marked crossing, where cars must stop for people walking.
zh: 兒童只能在有標示的穿越道過馬路，因為車輛在那裡必須停下來讓行人通過。

en: After breaking her leg, Mia had to walk on crutches for six weeks.
zh: Mia 摔斷腿後，有六個星期都必須拄著拐杖走路。

en: The mother bear stayed close to her cubs, teaching them how to find food in the forest.
zh: 熊媽媽緊緊守在小熊身邊，教牠們如何在森林裡覓食。

en: Cucumbers are mostly water, so they are a cool, healthy snack on a hot summer day.
zh: 小黃瓜大部分是水分，所以是炎熱夏天裡清涼又健康的點心。

en: Farmers in this area cultivate rice and tea on the hills, using methods passed down for generations.
zh: 這個地區的農民在山坡上種植稻米和茶，使用世代相傳的方法。

en: The cumulative effect of small daily habits, like reading ten minutes a day, can be huge over the years.
zh: 每天的小習慣（例如每天閱讀十分鐘）經年累月下來，累積的效果可能非常驚人。

en: To curb air pollution, the city has limited the number of old cars on its roads.
zh: 為了抑制空氣污染，市政府限制了路上老舊汽車的數量。

en: My parents set a curfew of ten o'clock, so I must be home before then on weekends.
zh: 我爸媽訂了十點的門禁，所以週末我必須在那之前回家。

en: Japanese curry is usually milder and sweeter than Indian curry, which often contains more spices.
zh: 日式咖哩通常比印度咖哩溫和、偏甜，印度咖哩則往往含有較多香料。

en: In Taiwan, it is customary to give red envelopes with money to children during Chinese New Year.
zh: 在台灣，農曆新年期間給孩子裝錢的紅包是一種習俗。

en: After being cheated several times, he became cynical and believed that no one could be trusted.
zh: 被騙了好幾次之後，他變得憤世嫉俗，認為沒有人值得信任。

en: The dancers dazzled the audience with their amazing skill and colorful, shining costumes.
zh: 舞者以驚人的技巧和色彩繽紛、閃閃發亮的服裝讓觀眾看得目不轉睛。

en: Standing next to the huge speakers, we were nearly deafened by the loud music at the concert.
zh: 站在巨大的音響旁邊，我們差點被演唱會的大聲音樂震聾。

en: Her quick goal in the final minute proved decisive, giving our team a 2-1 victory.
zh: 她在最後一分鐘迅速射門得分，成為決定性的一球，讓我們隊以二比一獲勝。

en: Thanks to years of dedication and hard work, the coach built one of the best teams in the country.
zh: 憑藉多年的奉獻與努力，這位教練打造出全國最好的隊伍之一。

en: Our teacher will deduct five points from your score for every day your report is late.
zh: 報告每遲交一天，老師就會從你的分數中扣掉五分。

en: After the earthquake, engineers deemed the old bridge too dangerous to use and closed it until repairs were finished.
zh: 地震過後，工程師認為那座舊橋太危險而無法使用，於是封閉到修復完成為止。

en: If you don't choose a language, English will be used as the default setting on this phone.
zh: 如果你沒有選擇語言，這支手機會以英文作為預設值。

en: After discovering a defect in the batteries, the company asked customers to return thousands of phones.
zh: 發現電池有缺陷後，這家公司要求顧客退回數千支手機。

en: In an act of defiance, the teenager refused to obey his parents' rules and stayed out late.
zh: 這個青少年違抗父母的規定，拒絕服從，在外面待到很晚。

en: Scientists still have no definitive answer to the question of why we dream.
zh: 關於我們為什麼會做夢，科學家仍沒有權威、確定的答案。

en: Good dental care, such as brushing twice a day, keeps your teeth and gums healthy.
zh: 良好的牙齒保健，例如一天刷兩次牙，能讓你的牙齒和牙齦保持健康。

en: Years of heavy fishing have depleted fish populations in many parts of the ocean.
zh: 多年來的過度捕撈，已經耗盡了海洋許多區域的魚群。

en: Staying up late deprives your body of the sleep it needs to grow and repair itself.
zh: 熬夜會剝奪身體成長和自我修復所需的睡眠。

en: The plane began its descent and landed safely at the airport twenty minutes later.
zh: 飛機開始下降，二十分鐘後安全降落在機場。

en: Lisa despises people who lie, so she always tells the truth even when it is difficult.
zh: Lisa 鄙視說謊的人，所以即使很困難，她也總是說實話。

en: From a young age, she seemed destined to become a great piano player, practicing for hours every day.
zh: 她從小似乎就注定要成為偉大的鋼琴家，每天都練琴好幾個小時。

en: You can detach the warm inner layer from this coat when the weather gets warmer.
zh: 天氣變暖時，你可以把這件大衣保暖的內層拆下來。

en: Airport officers detained the traveler for two hours to check his bags and documents.
zh: 機場人員將那名旅客留置了兩個小時，檢查他的行李和證件。

en: Ben was given detention after school for being late to class three times in one week.
zh: Ben 因為一週內上課遲到三次，被罰放學後留校。

en: High fines are meant to deter people from throwing trash on the streets.
zh: 高額罰款是為了嚇阻人們在街上亂丟垃圾。

en: Use only a small amount of detergent when washing clothes; too much can harm rivers and fish.
zh: 洗衣服時只要用少量清潔劑就好，用太多可能會危害河川和魚類。

en: The hungry boys devoured the whole pizza in less than five minutes.
zh: 那群飢餓的男孩不到五分鐘就把整個披薩狼吞虎嚥地吃光了。

en: Eating too much sugar over time can increase your risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
zh: 長期攝取過多糖分會增加罹患第二型糖尿病的風險。

en: Our busy manager dictated a letter while his assistant typed every word he said.
zh: 忙碌的經理口述一封信，他的助理則把他說的每個字都打下來。

en: In English class, we have a dictation test every week: the teacher reads words aloud, and we write them down.
zh: 英文課每週都有聽寫測驗：老師唸出單字，我們把它們寫下來。

en: In the novel, a powerful dictator controls everything people read, say, and even think.
zh: 在這本小說裡，一位權力強大的獨裁者控制人們所讀、所說，甚至所想的一切。

en: In history class, we learned how the country changed from a dictatorship into a democracy.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到這個國家如何從獨裁政體轉變為民主國家。

en: Many large trucks run on diesel, a fuel that produces more black smoke than gasoline.
zh: 許多大型卡車使用柴油，這種燃料產生的黑煙比汽油多。

en: Young children often cannot differentiate between what is real and what is imaginary.
zh: 幼童常常無法區分什麼是真實的、什麼是想像的。

en: Through careful diplomacy, the two countries solved their disagreement peacefully instead of going to war.
zh: 透過謹慎的外交手段，兩國和平解決了紛爭，而沒有走向戰爭。

en: All employees must follow the new directive, which requires them to wear name cards at work.
zh: 所有員工都必須遵守新的指示，上班時要配戴名牌。

en: A serious knee injury disabled the dancer, and she could no longer perform on stage.
zh: 一次嚴重的膝傷讓這位舞者失去行動能力，再也無法上台表演。

en: The flood was disastrous for local farmers, destroying most of their rice fields just before harvest.
zh: 這場洪水對當地農民來說是災難性的，在收成前夕摧毀了他們大部分的稻田。

en: Amy stared at her test score in disbelief; she could not believe that she had finally passed math.
zh: Amy 難以置信地盯著自己的考試分數；她不敢相信自己終於通過了數學。

en: Instead of discarding old clothes, many people now give them away or turn them into bags.
zh: 許多人現在不再丟棄舊衣服，而是把它們送人或改做成袋子。

en: Factories that discharge dirty water into rivers can kill fish and harm people living nearby.
zh: 將髒水排放到河裡的工廠可能會害死魚類，並危害住在附近的人。

en: Confucius had many disciples, and these followers later wrote down his words and ideas in a famous book.
zh: 孔子有許多門徒，這些追隨者後來把他的言論與思想寫成一本著名的書。

en: Students who cheat on exams may face disciplinary action, such as a warning or losing points.
zh: 考試作弊的學生可能會面臨懲戒處分，例如警告或扣分。

en: After the company's disclosure of its pollution data, the public finally understood the real risks to their health.
zh: 這家公司揭露污染數據之後，大眾終於了解自身健康所面臨的真實風險。

en: Sitting in front of a screen for hours can cause discomfort in your neck and eyes.
zh: 在螢幕前坐好幾個小時，可能會讓脖子和眼睛感到不適。

en: A good nurse is discreet and never shares patients' private information with other people.
zh: 好護士行事謹慎，從不把病人的隱私資料告訴別人。

en: In some ancient cultures, failing an important exam was seen as a disgrace to the whole family.
zh: 在某些古代文化中，重要考試落榜被視為全家的恥辱。

en: To the fans' dismay, the outdoor concert was canceled at the last minute because of a typhoon.
zh: 令歌迷沮喪的是，這場戶外演唱會因颱風在最後一刻取消了。

en: In a small team, no member is dispensable; everyone plays a necessary role.
zh: 在小團隊裡，沒有任何成員是可有可無的；每個人都扮演必要的角色。

en: A machine in the hospital lobby dispenses masks and hand cleaner to visitors for free.
zh: 醫院大廳的一台機器免費分發口罩和洗手液給訪客。

en: Disposable cups are used only once and then thrown away, creating a huge amount of waste.
zh: 一次性杯子只用一次就被丟掉，製造出大量垃圾。

en: Safe disposal of old batteries is important because they contain chemicals that can harm the soil.
zh: 妥善處理廢電池很重要，因為電池含有會危害土壤的化學物質。

en: Please dispose of used masks in the trash can instead of leaving them on the street.
zh: 請把用過的口罩丟進垃圾桶，不要丟在街上。

en: Although most members agreed with the plan, a few expressed dissent and asked for more discussion.
zh: 雖然大部分成員同意這項計畫，但有少數人表達異議，要求再多討論。

en: Turning off your phone while studying removes a major distraction and helps you focus.
zh: 讀書時關掉手機，能去除一大分心來源，幫助你專注。

en: Sailors in distress can send a signal for help, and nearby ships will come to rescue them.
zh: 遇險的水手可以發出求救信號，附近的船隻就會前來救援。

en: Loud noise from the construction site caused a disturbance to students taking exams next door.
zh: 工地傳來的巨大噪音干擾了隔壁正在考試的學生。

en: Farmers who diversify their crops, growing rice, beans, and fruit, face less risk from bad weather.
zh: 讓作物多樣化、同時種植稻米、豆類和水果的農民，較不怕惡劣天氣帶來的風險。

en: Building the new dam required the diversion of the river, sending its water away from the old village.
zh: 興建新水壩需要讓河流改道，把河水引離舊村莊。

en: Heavy rain forced the airline to divert the flight to another airport nearby.
zh: 豪雨迫使航空公司將班機轉降到附近另一座機場。

en: People who own stock in the company receive a dividend, a part of its profits, every year.
zh: 持有這家公司股票的人每年都會收到股息，也就是公司利潤的一部分。

en: Without enough rain, the crops seemed doomed to fail, and farmers feared a hungry winter.
zh: 雨水不足，農作物似乎注定歉收，農民擔心會度過一個挨餓的冬天。

en: Living in a school dormitory teaches students to share a room and manage their own time.
zh: 住在學校宿舍讓學生學會與人共用房間、管理自己的時間。

en: Experts are worried about the downward trend in birth rates, which have fallen for ten years.
zh: 專家擔心出生率的下降趨勢，因為它已經連續下滑十年。

en: Water always flows downward, moving from the mountains to the lower plains and finally to the sea.
zh: 水總是向下流，從山上流到較低的平原，最後流入大海。

en: Lisa's grandfather often dozes in his chair after lunch, taking a short nap before he reads again.
zh: Lisa 的爺爺午餐後常坐在椅子上打瞌睡，小睡片刻後再繼續看書。

en: To reduce air pollution quickly, the city took drastic measures, such as banning cars downtown.
zh: 為了迅速減少空氣污染，該市採取了激烈的措施，例如禁止汽車進入市中心。

en: Old houses often have a cold draught coming in through gaps around the windows in winter.
zh: 老房子冬天常有冷風從窗戶周圍的縫隙灌進來。

en: She keeps her socks and sweaters in the top drawer of the wooden dresser in her bedroom.
zh: 她把襪子和毛衣放在臥室木製衣櫃的最上層抽屜裡。

en: Instead of a heavy salad dressing, try a little olive oil and lemon juice for a healthier meal.
zh: 與其用濃重的沙拉醬，不如試試加一點橄欖油和檸檬汁，吃得更健康。

en: This new building serves a dual purpose: it is a library during the day and a concert hall at night.
zh: 這棟新建築有雙重用途：白天是圖書館，晚上則是音樂廳。

en: Many health claims online are dubious, so check them against reliable sources before believing them.
zh: 網路上許多健康說法都很可疑，所以在相信之前，要先用可靠的來源查證。

en: For most travelers, the duration of the flight from Taipei to Tokyo is about three hours.
zh: 對大多數旅客來說，從台北飛往東京的飛行時間大約是三個小時。

en: Many bats leave their caves at dusk, when the sun has set and the sky grows dark.
zh: 許多蝙蝠在黃昏時離開洞穴，那時太陽已經下山，天色逐漸變暗。

en: In the old fairy tale, Snow White lives in a small house with seven dwarfs.
zh: 在古老的童話故事裡，白雪公主和七個小矮人住在一間小房子裡。

en: Some ancient people dwelled in caves, where they were safe from wind, rain, and wild animals.
zh: 一些古代人類居住在洞穴裡，在那裡可以躲避風雨和野獸。

en: Traditional dwellings of the Tao people on Orchid Island are built partly below the ground to resist strong winds.
zh: 蘭嶼達悟族的傳統住屋有一部分蓋在地面下，以抵擋強風。

en: An eccentric scientist, he wore two different shoes every day and talked to the plants in his lab.
zh: 他是個古怪的科學家，每天穿兩隻不同的鞋子，還會跟實驗室裡的植物說話。

en: During a solar eclipse, the moon passes between the earth and the sun, blocking its light.
zh: 日蝕發生時，月球從地球和太陽之間經過，擋住太陽的光。

en: Some wild mushrooms are edible, but others are poisonous, so never eat one you cannot identify.
zh: 有些野生菇類可以食用，但有些有毒，所以絕不要吃你無法辨認的菇。

en: A newspaper editorial argued that the city should build more bike lanes to reduce traffic.
zh: 一篇報紙社論主張，市政府應該興建更多自行車道以減少車流。

en: When the lights in our classroom stopped working, the school called an electrician to fix the wires.
zh: 我們教室的燈不亮時，學校請了電工來修理電線。

en: Regular exercise can elevate your mood, making you feel happier and less stressed.
zh: 規律運動可以提升你的心情，讓你感覺更快樂、壓力更小。

en: In the 1800s, many emigrants left Europe and sailed to America in search of a better life.
zh: 在十九世紀，許多移民離開歐洲，航向美洲尋找更好的生活。

en: Her grandparents emigrated from Taiwan to Canada in the 1980s and opened a small restaurant there.
zh: 她的祖父母在 1980 年代從台灣移民到加拿大，並在那裡開了一家小餐廳。

en: Emigration from Ireland rose sharply in the 1840s, when crop failures forced many families to leave the country.
zh: 1840 年代愛爾蘭移出的人口急遽增加，當時農作物歉收迫使許多家庭離開這個國家。

en: Before the Internet, students often looked up facts in an encyclopedia at the school library.
zh: 在網路出現之前，學生常在學校圖書館的百科全書裡查資料。

en: Climbing Mount Everest is a dangerous endeavor that requires years of training and careful planning.
zh: 攀登聖母峰是一項危險的艱鉅任務，需要多年訓練和周詳的計畫。

en: Thanks to a large endowment from a former student, the university can offer more scholarships.
zh: 多虧一位校友的大筆捐贈，這所大學能提供更多獎學金。

en: Running a marathon tests your endurance, the ability to keep going for hours without stopping.
zh: 跑馬拉松考驗你的耐力，也就是連續好幾個小時不停下來的能力。

en: Adding a few pictures can enhance your report and make it easier for readers to understand.
zh: 加幾張圖片可以增強你的報告，讓讀者更容易理解。

en: A new museum exhibit aims to enlighten visitors about how plastic waste affects ocean life.
zh: 博物館的新展覽旨在啟發參觀者，讓他們了解塑膠垃圾如何影響海洋生物。

en: Reading widely can enrich your vocabulary and give you new ideas about the world.
zh: 廣泛閱讀能豐富你的詞彙，並讓你對世界產生新的想法。

en: More than three hundred students enrolled in the free online course on climate change.
zh: 超過三百名學生註冊了這門關於氣候變遷的免費線上課程。

en: Opening the window helps equalize the temperature between the warm room and the cool air outside.
zh: 打開窗戶有助於讓溫暖的室內和外面涼爽的空氣溫度變得相等。

en: Many people equate success with money, but happiness and good health matter just as much.
zh: 許多人把成功等同於金錢，但快樂和健康也同樣重要。

en: A guide will escort the visitors through the old castle and explain its long history.
zh: 一位導覽員將陪同參觀者走遍這座古堡，並解說它悠久的歷史。

en: Professor Lin is held in high esteem by her students, who admire her patience and knowledge.
zh: 林教授深受學生尊敬，他們欽佩她的耐心和學識。

en: Ancient Egyptians believed the soul would live on for eternity after the body died.
zh: 古埃及人相信，身體死後靈魂會永遠存在下去。

en: Before the typhoon arrived, officials evacuated people living near the river to a safe school building.
zh: 颱風來襲前，官員將住在河邊的居民撤離到一所安全的學校。

en: Pine trees are evergreen, keeping their green needles all year, while many other trees lose their leaves in fall.
zh: 松樹是常綠植物，一年到頭都保有綠色的針葉，而許多其他樹木則在秋天落葉。

en: For many people, the smell of fresh bread can evoke happy memories of mornings in a grandmother's kitchen.
zh: 對許多人來說，新鮮麵包的香味能喚起早晨在奶奶廚房裡的快樂回憶。

en: Every examinee must show a student card before entering the test room, and phones are not allowed.
zh: 每位應試者進入考場前都必須出示學生證，而且不准攜帶手機。

en: During the speaking test, the examiner asked Amy to describe her favorite place in Taiwan.
zh: 口說測驗時，主考官請 Amy 描述她在台灣最喜歡的地方。

en: Lisa excels at science, but she still needs more practice with writing essays.
zh: Lisa 擅長自然科學，但寫作文仍需要多加練習。

en: Our textbook includes an excerpt from the novel, a short passage that makes readers curious about the whole story.
zh: 我們的課本收錄了這部小說的摘錄，這段短文讓讀者對整個故事感到好奇。

en: Excess sugar in the diet can lead to weight gain, tooth decay, and other health problems.
zh: 飲食中過量的糖會導致體重增加、蛀牙和其他健康問題。

en: Feelings of exclusion, such as being left out by classmates, can make teenagers anxious and lonely.
zh: 被排除在外的感受，例如被同學冷落，可能讓青少年焦慮又孤單。

en: Students with a note from a doctor are exempt from the swimming test and do not have to take it.
zh: 有醫生證明的學生可免考游泳測驗，不必參加。

en: Pushing a heavy box across the floor requires you to exert a lot of force.
zh: 把沉重的箱子推過地板，需要施加很大的力量。

en: Government expenditure on health care has risen as the number of older people increases.
zh: 隨著老年人口增加，政府在醫療保健上的支出也隨之上升。

en: Always check the expiration date on milk before you drink it, or you may get sick.
zh: 喝牛奶前一定要檢查有效期限，否則你可能會生病。

en: My library card expires at the end of this month, so I need to renew it soon.
zh: 我的借書證這個月底到期，所以我得盡快去續辦。

en: Scientists extract oil from the seeds of this plant to make soap and skin cream.
zh: 科學家從這種植物的種子中萃取油脂，用來製作肥皂和護膚霜。

en: Joining extracurricular activities, such as the school band or debate club, helps students build friendships outside class.
zh: 參加課外活動，例如學校樂隊或辯論社，有助於學生在課堂以外建立友誼。

en: Our eyelashes protect our eyes by catching dust and small objects before they get in.
zh: 我們的睫毛會在灰塵和小東西進入眼睛之前把它們擋住，藉此保護眼睛。

en: When something flies toward your face, your eyelids close quickly to protect your eyes.
zh: 當有東西朝你的臉飛過來時，你的眼皮會迅速閉上以保護眼睛。

en: Staring at phone screens for too long in the dark may harm your eyesight over time.
zh: 在黑暗中長時間盯著手機螢幕，久而久之可能會損害視力。

en: Each fable in this book is a short animal story that teaches children a lesson about life.
zh: 這本書裡的每則寓言都是一個簡短的動物故事，教導孩子人生的道理。

en: Our club split into two factions, one wanting a music festival and the other preferring a sports day.
zh: 我們的社團分裂成兩個派系，一派想辦音樂節，另一派則偏好運動會。

en: Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit, a temperature scale still commonly used in the United States.
zh: 水在華氏 32 度結冰，華氏溫標在美國仍被普遍使用。

en: Her voice faltered with nerves as she began her speech, but she soon grew more confident.
zh: 她開始演講時因為緊張而聲音發抖，但很快就變得更有自信。

en: Your familiarity with the local language will make traveling in that country much easier.
zh: 熟悉當地語言，會讓你在那個國家旅行容易得多。

en: Lisa's fascination with stars began when she first looked through a telescope at age ten.
zh: Lisa 對星星的著迷，始於她十歲時第一次透過望遠鏡觀看。

en: Building a bridge across the wide river is technically feasible, but it would cost too much money.
zh: 在這條寬闊的河上建橋在技術上是可行的，但花費太高。

en: After weeks of illness, the old man felt too feeble to walk without help.
zh: 經過數週的病痛，那位老先生虛弱到無法自己走路。

en: Today pink is often seen as a feminine color, but many men also wear it proudly.
zh: 如今粉紅色常被視為女性化的顏色，但許多男性也大方地穿粉紅色。

en: Every year, floods along the Nile brought rich mud that increased the fertility of the land.
zh: 每年尼羅河沿岸的氾濫都會帶來富含養分的泥土，使土地更加肥沃。

en: Many farmers use natural fertilizer, such as animal waste, to help their crops grow.
zh: 許多農民使用天然肥料，例如動物糞便，來幫助作物生長。

en: Amy's aunt introduced her fiancé to the family, and they plan to marry next spring.
zh: Amy 的阿姨把她的未婚夫介紹給家人，他們計畫明年春天結婚。

en: Sharks use their fins to steer and keep their balance as they swim through the water.
zh: 鯊魚在水中游動時，用鰭來控制方向並保持平衡。

en: Oil and coal are finite resources, so once we use them up, they will be gone forever.
zh: 石油和煤炭是有限的資源，一旦用完就永遠沒有了。

en: During Chinese New Year, families set off firecrackers to scare away bad luck.
zh: 農曆新年期間，家家戶戶放鞭炮來驅走厄運。

en: People who fight fires wear special fireproof suits that protect them from intense heat and flames.
zh: 消防人員穿著特製的防火衣，保護他們免受高溫和火焰傷害。

en: Catching too many fish has damaged the local fishery, and some kinds of fish have almost disappeared.
zh: 過度捕撈已經破壞了當地漁場，有些魚類幾乎絕跡。

en: Old paint was coming off the walls in small flakes, so the workers painted the room again.
zh: 牆上的舊油漆一小片一小片地剝落，所以工人重新粉刷了房間。

en: At first the vase looked perfect, but a closer look revealed a tiny flaw near its bottom.
zh: 這個花瓶乍看很完美，但仔細一看，底部附近有個小瑕疵。

en: Trade flourished along the Silk Road, as goods and ideas moved between China and Europe.
zh: 絲路沿線貿易繁榮，商品和思想在中國與歐洲之間流通。

en: Ken flunked his math test because he spent the whole night playing games instead of studying.
zh: Ken 數學考試不及格，因為他整晚打電動而沒有讀書。

en: In the novel, the two kings begin as foes but later become close friends and allies.
zh: 在這部小說裡，兩位國王起初是敵人，後來卻成為親密的朋友和盟友。

en: In Taiwanese folklore, the Kitchen God reports on each family's behavior to heaven before the new year.
zh: 在台灣民間傳說中，灶神會在新年前向天庭報告每個家庭的行為。

en: Our team faced a formidable opponent: last year's champion, who had not lost a single game all season.
zh: 我們隊遇上一個難纏的對手：去年的冠軍，整季沒有輸過任何一場比賽。

en: Scientists first formulate a possible explanation and then design experiments to test whether it is true.
zh: 科學家先構想出一個可能的解釋，再設計實驗來檢驗它是否正確。

en: Even after most neighbors had moved away, the old farmer refused to forsake his village and land.
zh: 即使大多數鄰居都搬走了，那位老農夫仍拒絕拋棄他的村莊和土地。

en: Fans are excited about the singer's forthcoming album, which will be released next month.
zh: 歌迷對這位歌手即將推出的專輯感到興奮，專輯將在下個月發行。

en: Many breakfast cereals are fortified with extra vitamins and iron to make them more nutritious.
zh: 許多早餐穀片都額外添加維生素和鐵質來強化營養，使其更有益健康。

en: Chickens, ducks, and geese are common types of fowl raised on farms for eggs and meat.
zh: 雞、鴨和鵝是農場上常見的家禽，飼養來生產蛋和肉。

en: Lisa fell off her bike and suffered a fracture in her arm, so she wore a cast for weeks.
zh: Lisa 從腳踏車上摔下來，手臂骨折，所以打了好幾週的石膏。

en: A sweet fragrance of roses filled the garden, attracting both bees and visitors on spring mornings.
zh: 玫瑰的甜美香氣瀰漫整座花園，在春天的早晨吸引了蜜蜂和遊客。

en: Lily flowers are so fragrant that a single plant can fill a whole room with its sweet smell.
zh: 百合花非常芳香，一株就能讓整個房間充滿甜美的香氣。

en: Amy made a frantic search for her phone, running around the house just minutes before the bus came.
zh: Amy 在公車來前幾分鐘，在屋裡跑來跑去，瘋狂地找手機。

en: Ben is a fitness freak who goes to the gym every morning and counts every calorie he eats.
zh: Ben 是個健身狂，每天早上上健身房，還會計算自己吃下的每一卡熱量。

en: Traffic on the freeway was very slow because of an accident near the exit.
zh: 由於出口附近發生車禍，高速公路上的車流非常緩慢。

en: Friction between the tires and the road helps a car stop safely when the driver brakes.
zh: 輪胎與路面之間的摩擦力，能幫助汽車在駕駛煞車時安全停下。

en: Fumes from cars and factories pollute the air and can cause breathing problems.
zh: 汽車和工廠排放的廢氣會污染空氣，並可能引起呼吸問題。

en: The villagers were filled with fury when they learned the factory had been secretly dumping waste into their river.
zh: 村民得知工廠一直偷偷把廢棄物倒進他們的河裡，憤怒不已。

en: When too many machines are used at once, a fuse may blow and cut off the electricity.
zh: 同時使用太多電器時，保險絲可能會燒斷並切斷電源。

en: Ken's mother made a big fuss about a tiny scratch on his knee, though it did not even hurt.
zh: Ken 的媽媽對他膝蓋上的一點小擦傷大驚小怪，雖然那根本不痛。

en: Wild horses galloped across the open field, running at top speed and raising clouds of dust behind them.
zh: 野馬在空曠的原野上疾馳，全速奔跑，身後揚起陣陣塵土。

en: This movie tells the story of a gangster in 1920s Chicago who finally decides to leave his criminal life.
zh: 這部電影講述 1920 年代芝加哥一名歹徒最後決定脫離犯罪生涯的故事。

en: Each garment in the shop is made by hand from natural cotton, so the clothes cost more than usual.
zh: 店裡的每件衣服都是用天然棉花手工製成的，所以價格比一般衣服高。

en: Dad looked at the fuel gauge, saw the tank was nearly empty, and stopped at the next gas station.
zh: 爸爸看了看油表，發現油箱幾乎空了，就在下一個加油站停了下來。

en: In 2019, Taiwan became the first in Asia to allow gay couples to legally marry.
zh: 2019 年，台灣成為亞洲第一個允許同性伴侶合法結婚的地方。

en: Taiwan's geographical location makes it a common target for typhoons every summer and fall.
zh: 台灣的地理位置使它每年夏秋兩季常受颱風侵襲。

en: In geometry class, we learned how to calculate the area of circles, triangles, and other shapes.
zh: 在幾何課上，我們學會如何計算圓形、三角形和其他圖形的面積。

en: As the earth gets warmer, many glaciers are melting, and the extra water raises sea levels around the world.
zh: 隨著地球暖化，許多冰河正在融化，多出來的水使全球海平面上升。

en: Being a movie star looks glamorous, but the job often involves long hours and little privacy.
zh: 當電影明星看起來光鮮迷人，但這份工作常常工時很長，也沒什麼隱私。

en: Many young people are attracted by the glamour of the fashion world, with its beautiful clothes and famous models.
zh: 許多年輕人被時尚圈的魅力所吸引，那裡有漂亮的衣服和知名的模特兒。

en: A gleam of light appeared at the end of the dark tunnel, showing the way out.
zh: 漆黑隧道的盡頭出現一道微光，指出了出路。

en: Eagles can glide through the sky for a long time without moving their wings.
zh: 老鷹可以在空中滑翔很長一段時間而不必揮動翅膀。

en: Snow on the mountain glittered in the morning sun like millions of tiny diamonds.
zh: 山上的雪在晨光中閃閃發亮，宛如數百萬顆小鑽石。

en: Weeks of rainy weather filled the town with gloom, and many people felt tired and low.
zh: 連續好幾週的雨天讓小鎮籠罩在陰鬱之中，許多人都感到疲倦、情緒低落。

en: Jumping high into the air, the goalkeeper stopped the ball and saved the game for his team.
zh: 守門員高高躍起，擋下了球，為球隊保住了比賽。

en: As a gesture of goodwill, the two schools exchanged students for a week to learn about each other.
zh: 為了表達善意，兩所學校交換學生一週，以增進彼此了解。

en: Gorillas are the largest apes, and they live in groups in the forests of central Africa.
zh: 大猩猩是體型最大的猿類，成群生活在非洲中部的森林裡。

en: Many African American singers grew up singing gospel music in church on Sundays.
zh: 許多非裔美國歌手從小每逢星期天就在教堂唱福音音樂。

en: A grapefruit is larger than an orange and has a sour, slightly bitter taste.
zh: 葡萄柚比柳橙大，味道酸酸的，還帶點苦味。

en: Cows graze in the green fields all day, eating grass slowly under the sun.
zh: 牛群整天在綠色的田野上吃草，在陽光下慢慢地嚼著草。

en: Wash the pan with hot water and soap to remove the grease left from frying the eggs.
zh: 用熱水和肥皂清洗平底鍋，去除煎蛋留下的油脂。

en: Students let out a loud groan when their teacher announced another surprise test for Friday.
zh: 老師宣布星期五又要突擊考試時，學生們發出一陣大聲的哀嘆。

en: Showing its teeth, the dog growled at the stranger as a warning to stay away from the gate.
zh: 那隻狗露出牙齒，對陌生人低吼，警告他離大門遠一點。

en: Many passengers grumbled about the long delay, complaining that nobody had explained what was happening.
zh: 許多乘客抱怨誤點太久，埋怨沒有人解釋發生了什麼事。

en: A hacker broke into the company's computer system and stole the personal data of thousands of customers.
zh: 一名駭客入侵這家公司的電腦系統，竊取了數千名顧客的個人資料。

en: Hail the size of golf balls fell during the storm, damaging cars and crops.
zh: 暴風雨期間降下高爾夫球大小的冰雹，損壞了汽車和農作物。

en: Heavy snow hampered the rescue team's efforts, making it hard for them to reach the village.
zh: 大雪妨礙了救援隊的行動，讓他們很難抵達村莊。

en: Not speaking the local language can be a handicap when you look for a job abroad.
zh: 不會說當地語言，在國外找工作時可能是個不利條件。

en: Visitors can buy local handicrafts, such as bamboo baskets and hand-painted bowls, at the village market.
zh: 遊客可以在村裡的市集買到當地手工藝品，例如竹籃和手繪碗。

en: Posting mean comments online to harass other students is a form of bullying and should be reported.
zh: 在網路上發表惡意留言騷擾其他學生是一種霸凌，應該要檢舉。

en: Concrete hardens as it dries, becoming strong enough to support heavy buildings.
zh: 混凝土乾燥後會變硬，堅固到足以支撐沉重的建築。

en: Small enough to fit in a pocket, a harmonica can still produce rich and beautiful music.
zh: 口琴小到可以放進口袋，卻仍能吹奏出豐富優美的音樂。

en: Wind farms harness the power of the wind to produce clean electricity for thousands of homes.
zh: 風力發電場利用風力，為數千戶家庭產生乾淨的電力。

en: Many visitors believe the old castle is haunted by the ghost of a former queen.
zh: 許多遊客相信這座古堡有一位前任王后的鬼魂出沒。

en: Wearing headphones at high volume for hours can damage your hearing over time.
zh: 長時間以高音量戴耳機，久而久之可能會損害聽力。

en: A healthful diet includes plenty of vegetables, fruit, and whole grains, with little sugar or salt.
zh: 有益健康的飲食包含大量蔬菜、水果和全穀類，並且少糖少鹽。

en: After hiking all morning, we enjoyed a hearty lunch of beef soup, rice, and fresh vegetables.
zh: 健行了一整個早上後，我們享用了一頓豐盛的午餐，有牛肉湯、米飯和新鮮蔬菜。

en: A neat hedge of small bushes separates our garden from the neighbor's yard.
zh: 一道整齊的矮樹籬將我們的花園和鄰居的院子隔開。

en: Scary music in movies heightens the tension and makes the audience feel more nervous.
zh: 電影中的驚悚配樂會加強緊張氣氛，讓觀眾更加不安。

en: When it is summer in the Northern Hemisphere, it is winter in the Southern Hemisphere.
zh: 北半球是夏天的時候，南半球是冬天。

en: Brave rescue workers made a heroic effort to save the families trapped inside the burning building.
zh: 勇敢的救援人員英勇地奮力搶救受困在燃燒建築中的家庭。

en: Heroin is a dangerous drug that can quickly make users addicted and cause serious health problems.
zh: 海洛因是一種危險的毒品，很快就會讓使用者上癮，並引發嚴重的健康問題。

en: Health education textbooks explain that heterosexual means being attracted to people of the opposite sex.
zh: 健康教育課本說明，異性戀是指受到異性吸引。

en: In most companies, there is a hierarchy, with managers at the top and new workers near the bottom.
zh: 大多數公司都有階級制度，主管位居上層，新進員工則在底層附近。

en: In the movie, a group of thieves hijacks a train carrying gold, but the police soon catch them.
zh: 在電影中，一群盜賊劫持了一列載著黃金的火車，但警方很快就逮到了他們。

en: After cheering loudly at the basketball game, Amy found that her voice was hoarse the next day.
zh: 在籃球比賽中大聲加油後，Amy 隔天發現自己的聲音沙啞了。

en: In 1990, the World Health Organization decided that being homosexual should no longer be listed as a mental illness.
zh: 1990 年，世界衛生組織決定不再將同性戀列為精神疾病。

en: The famous scientist received an honorary degree from the university for her work on clean energy.
zh: 這位知名科學家因在潔淨能源方面的研究，獲得該大學頒發的榮譽學位。

en: Everyone in the village was hospitable, inviting us into their homes and serving us tea and fresh fruit.
zh: 村裡的每個人都很好客，邀請我們到家裡，還端上茶和新鮮水果招待我們。

en: Taiwan is known for its hospitality; local people often go out of their way to help tourists.
zh: 台灣以好客聞名；當地人常常特地幫助觀光客。

en: Ken's grandfather was hospitalized for a week after a bad fall, but he is recovering well now.
zh: Ken 的爺爺重重摔了一跤後住院一週，但現在恢復得很好。

en: Staying at a hostel is a cheap way for young travelers to see the world and meet new friends.
zh: 住青年旅館是年輕旅人看世界、結交新朋友的便宜方式。

en: A helicopter can hover in the air, staying in one place above the ground while rescuers climb down.
zh: 直升機可以在空中盤旋，停留在地面上方同一處，讓救難人員爬下去。

en: A good coach never humiliates players in front of others but gives them advice in private.
zh: 好教練從不在別人面前羞辱球員，而是私下給予建議。

en: I had a hunch that it would rain, so I brought an umbrella even though the sky was clear.
zh: 我直覺會下雨，所以即使天空晴朗還是帶了傘。

en: Learning to speak in front of a crowd was the biggest hurdle Lisa had to overcome.
zh: 學會在眾人面前說話，是 Lisa 必須克服的最大障礙。

en: Hybrid cars use both gas and electricity, so they produce less pollution than ordinary cars.
zh: 油電混合車同時使用汽油和電力，所以比一般汽車產生較少污染。

en: Good hygiene, such as washing your hands before meals, helps prevent the spread of disease.
zh: 良好的衛生習慣，例如飯前洗手，有助於預防疾病傳播。

en: Ken called his uncle a hypocrite for telling others to quit smoking while he smoked a pack every day.
zh: Ken 說他叔叔是偽君子，因為他叫別人戒菸，自己卻每天抽一包。

en: Only a small part of an iceberg is above the water; about ninety percent lies hidden below.
zh: 冰山只有一小部分露出水面，大約百分之九十藏在水面下。

en: During the Pingxi Lantern Festival, thousands of sky lanterns illuminate the night with warm, golden light.
zh: 平溪天燈節期間，數千盞天燈以溫暖的金色光芒照亮夜空。

en: Dark clouds and strong winds warned the fishermen that a storm was imminent, so they returned to port.
zh: 烏雲和強風警告漁民暴風雨即將來臨，所以他們返回港口。

en: It is imperative that drivers stay focused, because looking at a phone for even two seconds can cause an accident.
zh: 駕駛人務必保持專注，因為即使只看手機兩秒鐘也可能釀成車禍。

en: Chinese emperors lived in the imperial palace in Beijing for nearly five hundred years.
zh: 中國皇帝在北京的皇宮裡住了將近五百年。

en: Although the teacher never said it directly, there was an implicit warning in her words about cheating.
zh: 雖然老師從未直說，但她的話裡隱含著對作弊的警告。

en: With its tall towers and huge doors, the imposing cathedral makes every visitor feel tiny.
zh: 這座壯觀的大教堂有高聳的塔樓和巨大的門，讓每位參觀者都覺得自己渺小。

en: In the fairy tale, a wicked witch imprisons a girl in a tall tower with no door.
zh: 在這則童話中，一個邪惡的女巫把女孩囚禁在一座沒有門的高塔裡。

en: I am inclined to agree with Lisa, since her plan seems both cheaper and safer.
zh: 我傾向於同意 Lisa 的看法，因為她的計畫似乎既便宜又安全。

en: Our school tries to be inclusive, welcoming students of every background, ability, and culture.
zh: 我們學校努力營造包容的環境，歡迎各種背景、能力和文化的學生。

en: If you return library books late, you will incur a fine of five dollars per day.
zh: 如果你逾期歸還圖書館的書，每天會被罰款五元。

en: His indifference to the environment was clear; he never recycled and always left the lights on.
zh: 他對環境漠不關心，這點很明顯；他從不做資源回收，還總是開著燈。

en: Amy was indignant when she was blamed for the broken window, because she had not even been there.
zh: Amy 被怪罪打破窗戶時非常憤慨，因為她當時根本不在場。

en: Some medicines can induce sleepiness, so you should not drive after taking them.
zh: 有些藥物會引起睏意，所以服用後不應該開車。

en: As Taiwan began to industrialize in the 1960s, many people moved from farms to factories in the cities.
zh: 1960 年代台灣開始工業化，許多人從農村搬到城市的工廠工作。

en: The flu is highly infectious, spreading easily from person to person through coughing and close contact.
zh: 流感具有高度傳染性，會透過咳嗽和近距離接觸在人與人之間輕易傳播。

en: From the wet streets and umbrellas, we can infer that it rained earlier this morning.
zh: 從潮濕的街道和雨傘，我們可以推論今天早上稍早下過雨。

en: Typhoons can inflict serious damage on crops, leaving farmers with heavy losses.
zh: 颱風可能對農作物造成嚴重損害，讓農民蒙受重大損失。

en: Many penguins inhabit the cold coasts of Antarctica, where they live in large groups and hunt for fish.
zh: 許多企鵝居住在南極洲寒冷的海岸，成群生活並捕魚為食。

en: This small island has only about two hundred inhabitants, most of whom make a living by fishing.
zh: 這座小島只有大約兩百名居民，大多數靠捕魚維生。

en: The novel describes the injustice faced by poor workers who were paid very little for long hours.
zh: 這部小說描寫了貧窮工人所遭受的不公，他們工時很長，工資卻很少。

en: Inland areas are often hotter in summer and colder in winter than places near the sea.
zh: 內陸地區通常夏天比海邊更熱，冬天也比海邊更冷。

en: On a clear night in the mountains, you can see innumerable stars, far too many to count.
zh: 在山上晴朗的夜晚，你可以看到無數的星星，多到數不清。

en: Several parents called the school to inquire about the new rules for using phones in class.
zh: 幾位家長打電話到學校，詢問上課使用手機的新規定。

en: At her mother's insistence, Amy wore a heavy coat, even though she thought it was not that cold.
zh: 在媽媽的堅持下，Amy 穿了厚外套，儘管她覺得沒那麼冷。

en: Sea turtles have an instinctive ability to find the ocean right after they hatch, without any teaching.
zh: 海龜天生就有找到大海的本能，一孵化就知道往哪裡去，不需要任何教導。

en: Doctors suggest reducing your daily salt intake to lower the risk of heart disease.
zh: 醫生建議減少每日的鹽分攝取量，以降低罹患心臟病的風險。

en: Einstein, famous for his brilliant intellect, once said that imagination is more important than knowledge.
zh: 以過人智力聞名的愛因斯坦曾說，想像力比知識更重要。

en: At the international meeting, an interpreter translated the speaker's words from Japanese into English.
zh: 在國際會議上，一位口譯員把講者的話從日文翻成英文。

en: Drivers must stop at the red light and wait before going through the busy intersection.
zh: 駕駛人必須在紅燈前停下等待，才能通過繁忙的十字路口。

en: When two students began arguing loudly, a teacher had to intervene and help them calm down.
zh: 兩個學生開始大聲爭吵時，一位老師不得不出面介入，幫助他們冷靜下來。

en: Eating dinner together every night creates a sense of intimacy and closeness among family members.
zh: 每天晚上一起吃晚餐，能在家人之間營造親密感。

en: Some animals make their bodies look bigger in order to intimidate their enemies.
zh: 有些動物會讓身體看起來更大，藉此恐嚇敵人。

en: In English, a rising intonation at the end of a sentence often shows that you are asking a question.
zh: 在英文中，句尾語調上揚通常表示你在問問題。

en: Lisa was intrigued by the strange symbols on the ancient map and wanted to learn what they meant.
zh: Lisa 對古地圖上的奇怪符號感到好奇，想知道它們代表什麼意思。

en: I'm sorry to intrude, but may I ask you a quick question about the homework?
zh: 抱歉打擾了，我可以問你一個關於作業的簡短問題嗎？

en: Geese make loud noises when an intruder enters the farm, so some farmers keep them as guards.
zh: 有入侵者進入農場時，鵝會大聲鳴叫，所以有些農民養鵝來看守。

en: Your advice was invaluable; without it, I could never have finished the project on time.
zh: 你的建議非常寶貴；沒有它，我不可能準時完成這個專題。

en: Whenever Ken stays up late playing games, he invariably feels tired and sleepy in class the next day.
zh: 每當 Ken 熬夜打電動，隔天上課總是又累又想睡。

en: Before the holiday season, the store takes an inventory to check how many toys are still in stock.
zh: 在節慶旺季之前，這家店會盤點存貨，檢查還有多少玩具庫存。

en: It is ironic that the fire station burned down, since its workers are supposed to prevent fires.
zh: 消防局竟然被燒毀，真是諷刺，因為那裡的人員本該防止火災。

en: When people do not get enough sleep, they often become irritable and lose their temper easily.
zh: 人們睡眠不足時，常常變得易怒，很容易發脾氣。

en: Ken's habit of tapping his pen during tests irritates his classmates, who find the noise annoying.
zh: Ken 考試時用筆敲桌子的習慣讓同學很惱火，他們覺得那聲音很煩人。

en: Visitors can reach the tiny isle only by boat, and no cars are allowed there.
zh: 遊客只能搭船抵達這座小島，而且島上不准有汽車。

en: Mosquito bites often itch, but scratching them can make the skin red and sore.
zh: 蚊子叮咬常常會癢，但抓了可能會讓皮膚又紅又痛。

en: Green ivy has climbed up the walls of the old library, almost covering its windows.
zh: 綠色的常春藤爬滿了老圖書館的牆壁，幾乎遮住了窗戶。

en: In Chinese culture, jade is a precious green stone that stands for virtue and good luck.
zh: 在中華文化中，玉是一種珍貴的綠色石頭，象徵美德和好運。

en: Every evening, our school janitor cleans the hallways and repairs broken desks after students go home.
zh: 每天傍晚學生回家後，我們學校的工友會打掃走廊、修理壞掉的桌子。

en: Jasmine tea, made by mixing tea leaves with white jasmine flowers, has a sweet and pleasant smell.
zh: 茉莉花茶是將茶葉與白色茉莉花混合製成的，帶有香甜宜人的氣味。

en: We heard the jingle of keys at the door and knew that Mom had finally come home.
zh: 我們聽到門口鑰匙的叮噹聲，就知道媽媽終於回家了。

en: Riding at top speed, the young jockey guided his horse past the others and won the race.
zh: 年輕騎師全速騎行，引導他的馬超越其他對手，贏得比賽。

en: Santa Claus is usually shown as a jolly old man with a big laugh and a red suit.
zh: 聖誕老公公通常被描繪成一位愉快的老人，笑聲宏亮，穿著紅色衣服。

en: Chinese New Year is a joyous time when families gather to eat, laugh, and share good wishes.
zh: 農曆新年是歡樂的時節，家人團聚一起吃飯、歡笑，互道祝福。

en: This town grew up at the junction of two rivers, where boats could easily stop to trade goods.
zh: 這座小鎮在兩條河流的交會處發展起來，船隻可以在那裡輕鬆停靠、交易貨物。

en: During the festival, people travel long distances to visit their kin, including parents, cousins, and grandparents.
zh: 節日期間，人們長途跋涉去探望親人，包括父母、表兄弟姊妹和祖父母。

en: A visit to the science museum kindled Amy's interest in space, and she now dreams of visiting the moon.
zh: 參觀科學博物館激起了 Amy 對太空的興趣，她現在夢想能登上月球。

en: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable about local history and answered every question we asked.
zh: 我們的導遊對當地歷史非常了解，回答了我們提出的每一個問題。

en: In the old story, a poor lad from the village grows up to become a wise and respected leader.
zh: 在這個古老的故事裡，一個村裡的窮少年長大後成為睿智且受人尊敬的領袖。

en: Our landlady lives downstairs and always fixes problems in the apartment quickly when we call her.
zh: 我們的女房東住在樓下，每次我們打電話給她，她總會很快修好公寓裡的問題。

en: After days of heavy rain, a landslide blocked the mountain road with mud and rocks.
zh: 連續幾天豪雨後，一場山崩讓泥土和石塊堵住了山路。

en: Places at a high latitude, such as Norway, have very long days in summer and very short days in winter.
zh: 位於高緯度的地方，例如挪威，夏天白晝很長，冬天白晝很短。

en: To celebrate his birthday, the king held a lavish party with expensive food, gold plates, and hundreds of guests.
zh: 為了慶祝生日，國王舉辦了一場奢華的宴會，有昂貴的食物、金盤子和數百位賓客。

en: Dr. Wu explained the illness in layman's terms, using simple words that anyone could understand.
zh: 吳醫師用外行人也聽得懂的說法解釋病情，使用任何人都能理解的簡單詞彙。

en: With clear signs on every shelf, the new library's layout makes it easy for readers to find books.
zh: 新圖書館的空間配置讓讀者很容易找到書，每個書架上都有清楚的標示。

en: Lisa's family signed a one-year lease for the apartment and agreed to pay rent every month.
zh: Lisa 一家簽了一年的公寓租約，並同意每個月付房租。

en: Legislators discussed a new law that would stop people from hunting and selling wild animals.
zh: 立法委員討論了一項新法律，將禁止人們獵捕和販賣野生動物。

en: After a lengthy discussion lasting three hours, the club members finally agreed on a plan.
zh: 經過長達三小時的冗長討論，社團成員終於對計畫達成共識。

en: This film tells the life story of a lesbian artist whose paintings now hang in museums around the world.
zh: 這部電影講述一位女同性戀藝術家的生平故事，她的畫作如今掛在世界各地的博物館裡。

en: Planting trees along the streets can lessen noise and make summer heat easier to bear.
zh: 在街道兩旁種樹，可以減少噪音，讓夏天的炎熱更容易忍受。

en: Some snakes carry a lethal poison that can kill a person within hours without quick treatment.
zh: 有些蛇帶有致命的毒液，若不及時治療，可能在幾小時內致人於死。

en: If your dog damages someone's property, you may be liable and have to pay for the repairs.
zh: 如果你的狗損壞了別人的財物，你可能要負責並支付修理費。

en: Many women felt that the washing machine liberated them from hours of hard housework every week.
zh: 許多女性覺得洗衣機把她們從每週好幾個小時的繁重家事中解放出來。

en: In history class, we learned how the liberation of slaves in America gave millions of people their freedom.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到美國奴隸的解放如何讓數百萬人獲得自由。

en: At the history museum, we saw the uniform of a young army lieutenant, an officer of fairly low rank.
zh: 在歷史博物館裡，我們看到一位年輕陸軍中尉的制服，那是階級相當低的軍官。

en: My grandmother has a lifelong love of music; she began playing the piano at five and still plays at eighty.
zh: 我奶奶一生都熱愛音樂；她五歲開始彈鋼琴，到了八十歲仍在彈。

en: Sharing your worries with a good friend can lighten the heavy load you carry and help you feel better.
zh: 和好朋友分享你的煩惱，可以減輕你所背負的沉重負擔，讓你感覺好一些。

en: After hurting her ankle in the race, Lisa walked with a limp for nearly two weeks.
zh: Lisa 在比賽中扭傷腳踝後，走路一跛一跛的將近兩個星期。

en: The huge ocean liner carried more than two thousand passengers from Europe to America in about a week.
zh: 那艘巨大的遠洋郵輪載著兩千多名乘客，花了大約一週從歐洲航行到美洲。

en: Even after the concert ended, many fans lingered outside the hall, hoping to see the singer leave.
zh: 即使演唱會結束了，許多歌迷仍在場館外逗留，希望看到歌手離開。

en: My winter coat has a soft wool lining inside that keeps me warm on the coldest days.
zh: 我的冬季外套裡面有一層柔軟的羊毛內襯，在最冷的日子裡也能讓我保暖。

en: Doctors suggest that adults drink about two liters of water a day to stay healthy.
zh: 醫生建議成年人一天喝大約兩公升的水來保持健康。

en: Thanks to free public education, the literacy rate in Taiwan is very high, and almost everyone can read and write.
zh: 多虧有免費的公共教育，台灣的識字率非常高，幾乎每個人都能讀寫。

en: Taken in its literal sense, "break a leg" means hurting yourself, but actors say it to wish each other luck.
zh: 照字面意思來看，「break a leg」是指弄傷自己，但演員說這句話是為了互相祝好運。

en: In the past, only a small number of people were literate, so most could not read letters or books.
zh: 在過去，只有少數人識字，所以大多數人無法閱讀信件或書籍。

en: Farmers in the area raise livestock such as cows, pigs, and sheep, which need plenty of grass and water.
zh: 這個地區的農民飼養牛、豬和羊等家畜，牠們需要大量的草和水。

en: A small lizard ran across the warm rock, its long tail moving quickly behind it.
zh: 一隻小蜥蜴跑過溫暖的岩石，長長的尾巴在身後快速擺動。

en: Before swimming class, students put their bags and phones in their lockers and lock them with a key.
zh: 上游泳課前，學生把書包和手機放進置物櫃，再用鑰匙鎖好。

en: During our mountain trip, we stayed in a small wooden lodge near the lake for three nights.
zh: 在山區旅行期間，我們在湖邊一間木造小屋住了三個晚上。

en: The young doctor had lofty goals: she hoped to bring clean water and good health care to every village.
zh: 這位年輕醫師懷抱崇高的目標：她希望為每個村莊帶來乾淨的水和良好的醫療照護。

en: The company's logo, a simple green leaf, shows its promise to protect the environment.
zh: 這家公司的標誌是一片簡單的綠葉，展現了它保護環境的承諾。

en: After moving to a new city, Amy felt lonesome because she had no friends to talk to.
zh: 搬到新城市後，Amy 覺得很寂寞，因為她沒有朋友可以聊天。

en: Scientists studying longevity have found that people on some islands often live past one hundred years.
zh: 研究長壽的科學家發現，某些島嶼上的居民常常活過一百歲。

en: Sailors once found longitude hard to measure, so they often did not know how far east or west they were.
zh: 水手們過去覺得經度很難測量，所以常常不知道自己往東或往西走了多遠。

en: After swimming, Lisa rubbed some lotion on her dry skin to keep it soft and smooth.
zh: 游完泳後，Lisa 在乾燥的皮膚上擦了一些乳液，讓皮膚保持柔軟光滑。

en: Although millions of people buy lottery tickets, the chance of winning the top prize is extremely small.
zh: 雖然有數百萬人買彩券，但中頭獎的機率極低。

en: In summer, the pond is covered with pink lotus flowers, which grow from the mud yet stay clean and beautiful.
zh: 夏天時，池塘開滿粉紅色的蓮花，它們從泥中長出，卻依然潔淨美麗。

en: The principal's voice came through the loudspeaker, telling all students to gather on the playground.
zh: 校長的聲音從擴音器傳出來，要所有學生到操場集合。

en: Selling bubble tea turned out to be a lucrative business, earning the young owner a lot of money.
zh: 賣珍珠奶茶結果是一門很賺錢的生意，讓這位年輕老闆賺了很多錢。

en: Every night, the mother sang a soft lullaby to help her baby fall asleep.
zh: 每天晚上，那位媽媽都會輕聲唱一首搖籃曲，哄她的寶寶入睡。

en: The Lunar New Year, which follows the moon's calendar, usually falls in January or February.
zh: 農曆新年依照月亮的曆法，通常落在一月或二月。

en: Bright lights at night lure many insects, which fly toward them and circle around for hours.
zh: 夜裡明亮的燈光會引誘許多昆蟲，牠們朝燈光飛去，並繞著燈飛好幾個小時。

en: Thanks to heavy summer rains, the hills turned lush and green, covered with thick grass and trees.
zh: 多虧夏季的大雨，山丘變得青翠茂盛，長滿了濃密的草和樹木。

en: "Excuse me, madam, may I help you find a seat?" the polite young waiter asked the old lady.
zh: 「不好意思，女士，需要我幫您找座位嗎？」那位有禮貌的年輕服務生問那位老太太。

en: A microscope can magnify tiny cells hundreds of times, making them large enough for us to see.
zh: 顯微鏡可以把微小的細胞放大好幾百倍，讓它們大到我們能看得見。

en: The new airplane completed its maiden flight yesterday; it was the first time the plane had ever left the ground.
zh: 這架新飛機昨天完成了首航；那是它第一次離開地面。

en: Many tourists take a boat from the small island to the mainland, where there are more shops and hospitals.
zh: 許多遊客從小島搭船到本島，那裡有更多商店和醫院。

en: From the top of the hill, we had a majestic view of snowy mountains rising high above the clouds.
zh: 從山頂上，我們看見雄偉的景色：白雪覆蓋的群山高聳在雲層之上。

en: Visitors were amazed by the majesty of the ancient temple, with its huge stone pillars and golden roof.
zh: 遊客們對這座古老寺廟的雄偉莊嚴感到驚嘆，它有巨大的石柱和金色的屋頂。

en: The museum displays the original manuscript of the novel, written by hand with the author's own notes.
zh: 博物館展出這部小說的原始手稿，是作者親手寫成的，還附有作者本人的筆記。

en: In autumn, the leaves of the maple trees turn bright red and orange, attracting many visitors.
zh: 秋天時，楓樹的葉子變成鮮豔的紅色和橘色，吸引許多遊客前來。

en: One rude comment marred an otherwise perfect evening, leaving everyone at the party feeling upset.
zh: 一句無禮的話毀了原本完美的夜晚，讓派對上的每個人都覺得不愉快。

en: The new medicine showed only a marginal improvement, so doctors felt it was hardly better than the old one.
zh: 這種新藥只顯示出些微的改善，所以醫生認為它幾乎沒有比舊藥好。

en: Many teenagers learn martial arts, fighting sports from Asia that also teach balance, patience, and self-control.
zh: 許多青少年學習武術，這些源自亞洲的格鬥運動也能培養平衡感、耐心和自制力。

en: Visitors often marvel at the ancient pyramids, wondering how people built them without modern machines.
zh: 遊客常對古老的金字塔驚嘆不已，好奇人們在沒有現代機械的情況下是如何建造它們的。

en: It takes years of daily practice to achieve mastery of a musical instrument such as the violin.
zh: 要精通像小提琴這樣的樂器，需要多年每天不斷的練習。

en: When two classmates argued over the group project, our teacher stepped in to mediate and help them reach an agreement.
zh: 當兩位同學為了小組報告爭吵時，老師出面調解，幫助他們達成共識。

en: In medieval Europe, between about 500 and 1500, most people lived in small villages and worked on farms.
zh: 在中世紀的歐洲，大約西元 500 年到 1500 年間，大多數人住在小村莊並在農田工作。

en: Every morning, my aunt sits quietly and meditates for ten minutes to calm her mind before work.
zh: 每天早上，我阿姨會安靜地坐著冥想十分鐘，在上班前讓心情平靜下來。

en: Studies suggest that meditation, sitting quietly and focusing on your breathing, can reduce stress and improve sleep.
zh: 研究顯示，冥想——安靜地坐著並專注於呼吸——可以減輕壓力並改善睡眠。

en: The rainy autumn weather filled the poet with melancholy, a quiet sadness that appears in many of his poems.
zh: 多雨的秋天讓這位詩人滿懷憂鬱，這種淡淡的哀傷出現在他的許多詩作中。

en: Coaches say a winning mentality, the belief that you can succeed, matters as much as physical skill.
zh: 教練們說，致勝的心態——相信自己能成功——和身體技巧一樣重要。

en: This shop sells movie merchandise, such as T-shirts, cups, and toys, to fans of the film.
zh: 這家店販售電影周邊商品，例如 T 恤、杯子和玩具，賣給這部電影的影迷。

en: In the old fairy tale, a mermaid, half woman and half fish, gives up her voice to live on land.
zh: 在那則古老的童話裡，一條半人半魚的美人魚放棄了她的聲音，只為了在陸地上生活。

en: Every winter, migrant birds fly south from colder places to find food in Taiwan's warm rivers and fields.
zh: 每年冬天，候鳥從較冷的地方往南飛，到台灣溫暖的河流和田野覓食。

en: Parrots can mimic human speech, copying words and sounds so well that they often surprise their owners.
zh: 鸚鵡能模仿人類說話，牠們模仿字詞和聲音的功力好到常常讓主人大吃一驚。

en: At the welcome party, new students were encouraged to mingle and chat with classmates they had never met.
zh: 在迎新會上，新生被鼓勵四處交流，和從未見過的同學聊天。

en: The doctors called her quick recovery miraculous, since few patients with such a serious illness get well so fast.
zh: 醫生們稱她迅速康復是奇蹟，因為罹患如此嚴重疾病的病人很少能這麼快好起來。

en: The bottom drawer is full of miscellaneous items, from old keys and coins to broken pens and rubber bands.
zh: 最底層的抽屜塞滿了各式各樣的東西，從舊鑰匙、硬幣到壞掉的筆和橡皮筋都有。

en: The mischievous little boy hid his sister's shoes and laughed when she could not find them.
zh: 那個淘氣的小男孩把姊姊的鞋子藏起來，看她找不到就哈哈大笑。

en: In the old novel, the mistress of the house gives orders to the servants and manages the family's money.
zh: 在那部古老的小說裡，這家的女主人指揮僕人並管理家中的財務。

en: After the earthquake, the city quickly mobilized hundreds of volunteers to deliver food and water to families in need.
zh: 地震過後，市政府迅速動員數百名志工，把食物和水送給有需要的家庭。

en: The modernization of the old train station added elevators, electronic ticket machines, and clean new restrooms.
zh: 這座老火車站的現代化工程增設了電梯、電子售票機和乾淨的新廁所。

en: Our school plans to modernize its library by replacing old shelves with computers and comfortable study areas.
zh: 我們學校計畫將圖書館現代化，把舊書架換成電腦和舒適的讀書區。

en: After winning three games in a row, the team gained momentum and played with growing confidence.
zh: 連贏三場比賽後，這支隊伍氣勢大增，打得越來越有信心。

en: A monarch, such as a king or queen, usually rules for life and passes the crown to a child.
zh: 君主，例如國王或女王，通常終身統治，並把王位傳給子女。

en: These old coins in the museum have little monetary value, but they are rich in historical meaning.
zh: 博物館裡的這些古錢幣沒有什麼貨幣價值，但具有豐富的歷史意義。

en: To break the monotony of studying all day, Amy takes a short walk every hour.
zh: 為了打破整天讀書的單調，Amy 每個小時都會去散步一下。

en: A monstrous wave, taller than a five-story building, crashed onto the beach during the storm.
zh: 暴風雨期間，一道比五層樓還高的巨浪猛烈地打上海灘。

en: Teenagers can be moody, feeling happy one moment and upset the next, partly because of changes in their bodies.
zh: 青少年可能情緒化，前一刻開心、下一刻就難過，部分原因是身體的變化。

en: The coach's encouraging speech lifted team morale, and the players went back onto the field full of hope.
zh: 教練激勵人心的談話提振了球隊士氣，球員們滿懷希望地回到場上。

en: In Greek myths, the gods live forever, while humans are mortal and must one day die.
zh: 在希臘神話中，眾神長生不死，而人類終究難逃一死。

en: Many women say that motherhood changed their lives, teaching them patience and a new kind of love.
zh: 許多女性說，成為母親改變了她們的人生，教會她們耐心和一種全新的愛。

en: Our school motto, "Never stop learning," is painted in large letters above the main gate.
zh: 我們的校訓「永不停止學習」以大字漆在校門上方。

en: Ants had built a small mound of soil near the tree, with tiny holes leading down into the ground.
zh: 螞蟻在樹旁堆起了一座小土堆，上面有通往地底的小洞。

en: Hundreds of people gathered to mourn the beloved old doctor who had cared for their town for fifty years.
zh: 數百人聚在一起，哀悼那位照顧他們小鎮五十年、深受愛戴的老醫生。

en: The violin played a slow, mournful tune that made many people in the audience cry.
zh: 小提琴奏出一首緩慢而哀傷的曲子，讓許多觀眾落淚。

en: Every Saturday, my dad mows the lawn so that the grass in our yard stays short and neat.
zh: 每個星期六，我爸爸都會割草，讓我們院子裡的草保持短而整齊。

en: The painter called his garden his muse, saying its flowers gave him ideas for nearly all his works.
zh: 這位畫家稱他的花園為他的繆思，說園中的花朵給了他幾乎所有作品的靈感。

en: My grandfather has a thick gray mustache above his lip, which he cuts carefully every morning.
zh: 我爺爺的上唇有一撇濃密的灰色八字鬍，他每天早上都會仔細修剪。

en: During the meeting, everyone was asked to mute their phones so that no sound would interrupt the speaker.
zh: 開會期間，每個人都被要求把手機調成靜音，以免任何聲音打斷講者。

en: My mother keeps nagging me to clean my room, reminding me again and again until I finally do it.
zh: 我媽媽一直嘮叨要我整理房間，一再提醒，直到我終於動手為止。

en: The film is narrated by a famous actor whose warm voice tells the story of life in the ocean.
zh: 這部影片由一位知名演員旁白敘述，他溫暖的聲音訴說著海洋生物的故事。

en: In the novel, the narrator is a twelve-year-old girl who tells the story through her own eyes.
zh: 在這部小說中，敘述者是一個十二歲的女孩，她透過自己的眼睛來講述故事。

en: In history class, we learned how nationalism, a strong love for one's own nation, spread across Europe in the 1800s.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到民族主義——對自己民族的強烈熱愛——如何在十九世紀傳遍歐洲。

en: Long before phones had maps, sailors used the stars to navigate across the open sea.
zh: 早在手機有地圖之前，水手就靠星星在廣闊的大海上航行。

en: Modern cars have navigation systems that show drivers the fastest route to where they are going.
zh: 現代汽車配有導航系統，能告訴駕駛前往目的地最快的路線。

en: Because Ben is nearsighted, he can read books easily but must wear glasses to see the board clearly.
zh: 因為 Ben 近視，他看書很輕鬆，但必須戴眼鏡才能看清楚黑板。

en: In the United States, a nickel is a small coin worth five cents, so twenty of them make one dollar.
zh: 在美國，nickel 是價值五美分的小硬幣，所以二十枚就是一美元。

en: When you have a cold, one nostril is often blocked, making it hard to breathe through your nose.
zh: 感冒時，常常會有一邊鼻孔塞住，讓人很難用鼻子呼吸。

en: One notable feature of the building is its green roof, which is covered with plants that help cool the city.
zh: 這棟建築值得注意的特色之一是它的綠屋頂，上面種滿了有助於讓城市降溫的植物。

en: This road is notorious for traffic jams, and drivers often spend an hour moving just a few kilometers.
zh: 這條路以塞車出了名，駕駛常常花一個小時只前進幾公里。

en: Healthy soil nourishes plants by giving them the water and minerals they need to grow.
zh: 健康的土壤提供植物生長所需的水分和礦物質，藉此滋養植物。

en: As a novice at cooking, Lisa followed every step of the recipe carefully, while her experienced mother never used one.
zh: 身為烹飪新手，Lisa 小心翼翼地照著食譜的每個步驟做，而她經驗豐富的媽媽從來不用食譜。

en: The nucleus is the control center of a cell, holding most of the information that the cell needs to live.
zh: 細胞核是細胞的控制中心，儲存著細胞生存所需的大部分資訊。

en: The art museum displays ancient Greek statues, including several nude figures, as examples of classical art.
zh: 這間美術館展出古希臘雕像，其中包括幾尊裸體人像，作為古典藝術的範例。

en: Good teachers nurture their students' curiosity, encouraging them to ask questions and explore new ideas.
zh: 好老師會培養學生的好奇心，鼓勵他們提問並探索新的想法。

en: After hours of walking across the desert, the travelers finally reached an oasis with palm trees and fresh water.
zh: 在沙漠中走了好幾個小時後，旅人們終於抵達一片有棕櫚樹和淡水的綠洲。

en: Before starting work, new doctors take an oath, promising to protect patients and do no harm.
zh: 開始執業前，新進醫師會宣誓，承諾保護病人、絕不造成傷害。

en: For breakfast, I often eat a warm bowl of oatmeal with fruit, which keeps me full until lunch.
zh: 早餐我常吃一碗加了水果的熱燕麥片，讓我一直飽到午餐。

en: By law, drivers are obliged to wear seat belts, so anyone who refuses may have to pay a fine.
zh: 依照法律，駕駛必須繫安全帶，所以拒絕繫的人可能得繳罰款。

en: Many teenagers are obsessed with their phones, checking them dozens of times a day.
zh: 許多青少年對手機著迷，一天要查看好幾十次。
