en: My obstinate little brother refused to wear a coat, even though it was freezing outside.
zh: 我那頑固的弟弟拒絕穿外套，即使外面冷得要命。

en: Earthquakes are a common occurrence in Taiwan, so students practice what to do during one several times a year.
zh: 地震在台灣是常有的事，所以學生每年都會演練好幾次地震發生時該怎麼做。

en: An octopus has eight arms and can change its color to hide from enemies in the ocean.
zh: 章魚有八隻腕足，還能改變身體顏色，以躲避海中的敵人。

en: The strong odor of bad eggs told us that the food in the box was no longer safe to eat.
zh: 一股強烈的臭雞蛋味告訴我們，盒子裡的食物已經不能吃了。

en: The government plans to build more offshore wind farms, placing huge wind machines in the sea to produce clean energy.
zh: 政府計畫興建更多離岸風場，在海上設置巨大的風力發電機來生產乾淨能源。

en: Most birds care for their offspring until the young are strong enough to fly and find food.
zh: 大多數鳥類會照顧牠們的後代，直到幼鳥強壯到能飛行和覓食為止。

en: The old train line is still operative, carrying passengers between the two mountain towns every day.
zh: 這條老鐵路仍在運作，每天載送乘客往返兩個山城之間。

en: In history class, we read how some rulers oppressed poor farmers, taking most of their crops and limiting their freedom.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀到有些統治者如何壓迫貧窮的農民，奪走他們大部分的作物並限制他們的自由。

en: The novel describes a village's long struggle against oppression and its people's dream of living freely.
zh: 這部小說描寫一個村莊長期對抗壓迫，以及村民渴望自由生活的夢想。

en: Being lost in the mountains for two days was a terrible ordeal, but the two students survived by staying calm.
zh: 在山裡迷路兩天是一場可怕的磨難，但那兩名學生靠著保持冷靜活了下來。

en: The students left the building in an orderly way, walking quietly in neat lines during the fire drill.
zh: 消防演習時，學生們有秩序地離開大樓，安靜地排成整齊的隊伍行走。

en: The organizers of the music festival thanked the volunteers who helped clean up after the event.
zh: 音樂節的主辦人感謝在活動結束後幫忙打掃的志工。

en: The first week of college helps new students orient themselves to campus life and find their way around.
zh: 大學的第一週幫助新生適應校園生活，並熟悉校園環境。

en: The museum's collection of oriental art includes Chinese paintings, Japanese screens, and Korean pottery.
zh: 這間博物館的東方藝術收藏包括中國畫、日本屏風和韓國陶器。

en: Many historians believe that the game of chess originated in India about 1,500 years ago.
zh: 許多歷史學家認為，西洋棋起源於大約一千五百年前的印度。

en: We decorated the Christmas tree with shiny glass ornaments and colorful lights.
zh: 我們用閃亮的玻璃裝飾品和彩色燈泡裝飾聖誕樹。

en: Children who have lost their parents may live in an orphanage until a new family adopts them.
zh: 失去父母的孩子可能會住在孤兒院，直到有新家庭收養他們。

en: Instead of following orthodox teaching methods, the teacher used games and songs to explain grammar.
zh: 這位老師沒有採用正統的教學方法，而是用遊戲和歌曲來講解文法。

en: This recipe calls for eight ounces of cheese, which is about 227 grams.
zh: 這份食譜需要八盎司的起司，大約是 227 公克。

en: An outbreak of flu at the school forced it to close for a week to stop the illness from spreading.
zh: 學校爆發流感，被迫停課一週，以防止疾病擴散。

en: Lisa is outgoing and loves meeting new people, while her twin sister is quiet and shy.
zh: Lisa 個性外向，喜歡認識新朋友，而她的雙胞胎妹妹則安靜又害羞。

en: Our class went on an outing to the zoo, where we spent the whole day watching animals.
zh: 我們班去動物園郊遊，在那裡花了一整天觀察動物。

en: Many cities have outlawed plastic bags, making it against the law for shops to give them out for free.
zh: 許多城市已明令禁止塑膠袋，商店免費提供塑膠袋是違法的。

en: Despite her illness, she kept a positive outlook on life, always expecting good things to come.
zh: 儘管生病，她依然對人生保持正面的看法，總是期待好事到來。

en: In our class, girls outnumber boys two to one, so there are twenty girls and only ten boys.
zh: 我們班女生人數是男生的兩倍，所以有二十個女生，只有十個男生。

en: Plans to cut down the old trees caused outrage among local residents, who protested in front of city hall.
zh: 砍掉老樹的計畫引起當地居民的憤怒，他們到市政府前抗議。

en: Ticket prices for the concert were outrageous; most students simply could not afford to pay that much.
zh: 這場演唱會的票價高得離譜；大多數學生根本付不起那麼多錢。

en: Our plan was rejected outright; the committee said no without even discussing it.
zh: 我們的計畫被斷然否決；委員會連討論都沒有就說不。

en: At the outset of the project, the team set clear goals so everyone knew what to do from the start.
zh: 在專案一開始，團隊就設定了明確的目標，讓每個人從頭就知道該做什麼。

en: My grandparents live on the outskirts of Tainan, far from the busy city center.
zh: 我的祖父母住在台南郊區，遠離熱鬧的市中心。

en: Despite her outward calm, Amy was actually very nervous before the speech contest.
zh: 儘管 Amy 外表看起來很冷靜，她在演講比賽前其實非常緊張。

en: When a stone falls into a still pond, small waves spread outward in growing circles.
zh: 當一顆石頭落入平靜的池塘，小小的波紋會以越來越大的圓圈向外擴散。

en: Exercise is good for you, but don't overdo it, because too much can hurt your muscles.
zh: 運動對你有益，但不要做得過火，因為運動過量可能會傷到肌肉。

en: After days of heavy rain, the river began to overflow its banks and flood nearby fields.
zh: 連續幾天的大雨後，河水開始溢出河岸，淹沒附近的田地。

en: While waiting for the bus, I happened to overhear two strangers talking about a new restaurant nearby.
zh: 等公車時，我無意中聽到兩個陌生人在聊附近一家新開的餐廳。

en: Since the two classes overlap by fifteen minutes, Ben cannot attend both on Wednesdays.
zh: 由於這兩堂課重疊了十五分鐘，Ben 星期三無法兩堂都上。

en: Doctors warn that overwork and lack of sleep can harm both your body and your mind.
zh: 醫生警告，過勞和睡眠不足會同時傷害你的身體和心理。

en: Oysters are sea animals with hard shells, and some of them can produce pearls inside.
zh: 牡蠣是有堅硬外殼的海洋生物，其中有些能在殼內產生珍珠。

en: High above the earth, the ozone layer protects living things from the sun's harmful light.
zh: 在地球高空中，臭氧層保護生物免受太陽有害光線的傷害。

en: Each packet of seeds comes with instructions telling gardeners when and how deep to plant them.
zh: 每一小包種子都附有說明，告訴園丁何時種、要種多深。

en: We took turns paddling the small boat across the quiet lake, moving slowly toward the other side.
zh: 我們輪流划著小船橫越平靜的湖面，慢慢地朝對岸前進。

en: Since a paperback is cheaper and lighter than a book with a hard cover, it is easy to carry.
zh: 由於平裝書比精裝書便宜又輕，所以很方便攜帶。

en: It is a paradox that the more choices people have, the harder it becomes for them to feel satisfied.
zh: 這是一種矛盾：人們的選擇越多，就越難感到滿足。

en: Heavy snow paralyzed the city, stopping trains and buses for two whole days.
zh: 大雪讓整座城市癱瘓，火車和公車停駛了整整兩天。

en: Members of parliament meet in the capital to discuss and pass new laws for the country.
zh: 國會議員在首都開會，討論並通過國家的新法律。

en: Reading is my favorite pastime; I spend most of my free time with a good book.
zh: 閱讀是我最喜愛的消遣；我大部分的空閒時間都和一本好書為伴。

en: At the history museum, we read about a patriot who spent his whole life serving his country.
zh: 在歷史博物館裡，我們讀到一位畢生為國家奉獻的愛國者。

en: During international sports events, many people feel patriotic and proudly cheer for athletes from their own country.
zh: 在國際運動賽事期間，許多人會充滿愛國情懷，驕傲地為自己國家的選手加油。

en: To attract a female, the male peacock spreads its long, colorful tail feathers.
zh: 為了吸引雌孔雀，雄孔雀會展開牠那長而色彩繽紛的尾羽。

en: The children collected smooth pebbles on the beach and painted them in bright colors.
zh: 孩子們在海灘上撿拾光滑的鵝卵石，並把它們塗上鮮豔的顏色。

en: Lisa could not resist taking a quick peek at her present before the party started.
zh: Lisa 忍不住在派對開始前偷看了一眼她的禮物。

en: Our final decision is still pending, so we will not know the results until next week.
zh: 我們的最終決定仍然待定，所以要到下週才會知道結果。

en: A peninsula is land surrounded by water on three sides, like the southern tip of Taiwan.
zh: 半島是三面環水的陸地，就像台灣的最南端。

en: A small bird perched on the branch outside my window, singing loudly every morning.
zh: 一隻小鳥棲息在我窗外的樹枝上，每天早上大聲歌唱。

en: Many animals face peril as their forests are cut down, and some may soon disappear forever.
zh: 隨著森林遭到砍伐，許多動物面臨危險，有些可能很快就會永遠消失。

en: Many plants perished during the long dry summer because there was not enough water.
zh: 在漫長乾旱的夏天裡，許多植物因為缺水而死亡。

en: In some schools, using phones in class is permissible only when the teacher allows it for research.
zh: 在某些學校，只有在老師允許用來查資料時，上課使用手機才是可以的。

en: Although she failed the test twice, Amy persevered and finally passed on her third try.
zh: 雖然考試失敗了兩次，Amy 仍堅持不懈，終於在第三次通過了。

en: Thanks to her persistence, the scientist kept trying after many failures and finally made an important discovery.
zh: 多虧她的堅持，這位科學家在多次失敗後仍不斷嘗試，終於有了重要的發現。

en: If you have a persistent cough that lasts more than three weeks, you should see a doctor.
zh: 如果你持續咳嗽超過三個星期，就應該去看醫生。

en: In Britain, people say "petrol," while people in the United States call the same fuel for cars "gas."
zh: 在英國，人們說「petrol」，而美國人則把同樣的汽車燃料叫作「gas」。

en: Most plastic is made from petroleum, the same oil that is used to produce fuel for cars.
zh: 大多數塑膠是由石油製成的，也就是用來生產汽車燃料的那種油。

en: At the drugstore, the pharmacist explained how often I should take the medicine and what to avoid.
zh: 在藥局裡，藥劑師向我說明藥要多久吃一次，以及要避免哪些事情。

en: After seeing the doctor, I went to the pharmacy next door to pick up my medicine.
zh: 看完醫生後，我到隔壁的藥局領藥。

en: Before performing at the national concert hall, the young pianist practiced six hours a day.
zh: 在國家音樂廳演出前，這位年輕的鋼琴家每天練琴六小時。

en: Tourists in crowded places should watch their wallets, as pickpockets may quietly steal from their bags.
zh: 在擁擠的地方，遊客應該看好自己的錢包，因為扒手可能會悄悄地從包包裡偷東西。

en: Every year, thousands of pilgrims walk for days to visit the famous temple and pray.
zh: 每年都有成千上萬的朝聖者步行好幾天，前往那座有名的廟宇祈福。

en: Many teenagers get pimples on their faces because of changes in their bodies during these years.
zh: 許多青少年在這個階段因為身體的變化而在臉上長青春痘。

en: Add a pinch of salt to the soup; just a small amount will bring out the flavor.
zh: 在湯裡加一小撮鹽；只要一點點就能帶出味道。

en: In the 1300s, a terrible plague spread across Europe and killed millions of people.
zh: 在十四世紀，一場可怕的瘟疫席捲歐洲，奪走了數百萬人的性命。

en: In the past, large plantations grew sugar and coffee, using many workers to farm the huge fields.
zh: 過去，大型農場種植甘蔗和咖啡，雇用許多工人耕種廣大的田地。

en: Our local playwright spent three years writing her new play, which will be performed next spring.
zh: 我們當地的劇作家花了三年寫她的新劇本，這齣戲將在明年春天上演。

en: Long ago, farmers used strong animals such as cows to plow their fields before planting rice.
zh: 很久以前，農民會用牛之類的強壯動物來犁田，然後才種稻。

en: Pneumonia, a serious infection of the lungs, can make it hard for patients to breathe.
zh: 肺炎是一種嚴重的肺部感染，可能會讓病人呼吸困難。

en: Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt, so melting ice makes it harder for them to survive.
zh: 北極熊依賴海冰來獵食，所以冰層融化讓牠們更難生存。

en: She sat by the window for hours, pondering what to study at university.
zh: 她在窗邊坐了好幾個小時，沉思著大學要讀什麼。

en: At the farm, the children took turns riding a gentle little pony around the field.
zh: 在農場裡，孩子們輪流騎著一匹溫馴的小馬繞著草地走。

en: This small island is populated mainly by fishermen and their families, about 500 people in total.
zh: 這座小島上的居民主要是漁夫和他們的家人，總共大約五百人。

en: When we arrived at the hotel, a porter carried our heavy bags up to our room.
zh: 我們抵達飯店時，一位行李員把我們沉重的行李搬到房間。

en: Sitting with poor posture for hours can cause back pain, so try to keep your back straight.
zh: 長時間以不良姿勢坐著可能會導致背痛，所以要盡量保持背部挺直。

en: This medicine is very potent, so patients should take only one small pill a day.
zh: 這種藥非常強效，所以病人一天只應吃一顆小藥丸。

en: Local farms raise poultry, such as chickens, ducks, and geese, for both eggs and meat.
zh: 當地農場飼養雞、鴨、鵝等家禽，以生產蛋和肉。

en: Our coach preached about the importance of hard work so often that some players stopped listening.
zh: 我們教練太常說教努力的重要性，以至於有些球員不再聽了。

en: A flash of lightning always precedes the sound of thunder because light travels much faster than sound.
zh: 閃電總是先於雷聲出現，因為光的傳播速度比聲音快得多。

en: Since the court's decision set a precedent, similar cases in the future will likely be decided the same way.
zh: 由於法院的判決立下了先例，未來類似的案件很可能會以同樣的方式判決。

en: Heart doctors must work with great precision, since even a tiny mistake can affect a patient's health.
zh: 心臟科醫師工作時必須非常精確，因為即使是極小的錯誤也可能影響病人的健康。

en: Our new principal is more open to students' ideas than her predecessor, who retired last year.
zh: 我們的新校長比去年退休的前任校長更願意接納學生的想法。

en: Prehistoric people drew animals on cave walls long before writing was invented.
zh: 史前人類早在文字發明之前，就在洞穴牆壁上畫動物。

en: Fans waited in line for hours to attend the premiere, the first public showing of the new film.
zh: 影迷們排隊等了好幾個小時，只為了參加新電影的首映，也就是它第一次公開放映。

en: As the oldest member of the committee, Grace will preside over the meeting and make sure everyone can speak.
zh: 身為委員會中最年長的成員，Grace 將主持會議，並確保每個人都有發言機會。

en: Winning the international prize brought the small university great prestige and attracted top students.
zh: 贏得這項國際大獎為這所小型大學帶來了極高的聲望，也吸引了頂尖的學生。

en: Regular health checks are a form of preventive medicine, helping doctors find problems before they become serious.
zh: 定期健康檢查是一種預防醫學，能幫助醫生在問題變嚴重之前就發現它們。

en: Before class, students should preview the new lesson so they can follow the teacher more easily.
zh: 上課前，學生應該預習新課程，這樣才能更容易跟上老師。

en: This ancient vase is priceless; no amount of money could replace it if it were broken.
zh: 這只古老的花瓶是無價之寶；萬一打破了，再多錢也無法取代。

en: Some governments decide to privatize their national airlines, selling them to private companies.
zh: 有些政府決定將國營航空公司民營化，把它們賣給私人公司。

en: In 1977, scientists sent a probe into space, and it is still sending information back to Earth today.
zh: 1977 年，科學家把一架探測器送上太空，它至今仍在把資訊傳回地球。

en: A long procession of dancers and drum players moved slowly through the streets during the temple festival.
zh: 廟會期間，一支由舞者和鼓手組成的長長隊伍緩緩穿過街道。

en: Many universities require proof of English proficiency, such as a high score on a language test.
zh: 許多大學要求出示英語能力證明，例如語言測驗的高分成績。

en: Since the prohibition on smoking in restaurants began, the air inside has become much cleaner for customers.
zh: 自從餐廳開始禁止吸菸，室內空氣對顧客來說變得乾淨許多。

en: Rockets are propelled by hot gases rushing out of their engines at high speed.
zh: 火箭是靠從引擎高速噴出的熱氣體來推進的。

en: While poetry often uses short lines, prose is written in ordinary sentences, as in novels and newspaper articles.
zh: 詩常使用簡短的詩行，而散文則是用一般的句子寫成，例如小說和報紙文章。

en: Shop owners say they will prosecute anyone caught stealing, taking them to court to face the charges.
zh: 店家表示，他們會起訴任何被抓到偷竊的人，把他們送上法院面對指控。

en: Our university holds an open day for prospective students who are thinking of applying next year.
zh: 我們大學為明年考慮申請入學的準新生舉辦校園開放日。

en: Engineers tested an early prototype of the robot before producing the final version.
zh: 工程師們在生產最終版本之前，先測試了這款機器人的早期原型。

en: As the proverb says, "Practice makes perfect," so keep working and you will improve.
zh: 正如諺語所說：「熟能生巧。」所以繼續努力，你就會進步。

en: In Canada, each provincial government runs its own schools and hospitals within its area.
zh: 在加拿大，各省政府自行管理其轄區內的學校和醫院。

en: Dates on the schedule are provisional and may change once we confirm the guest speaker.
zh: 行程表上的日期是暫定的，等我們確認演講嘉賓後可能會更改。

en: After years of studying medicine, she chose psychiatry because she wanted to help people with mental illness.
zh: 在學醫多年之後，她選擇了精神醫學，因為她想幫助有心理疾病的人。

en: A magician on TV claimed to be psychic, saying he could read people's minds, but scientists found no proof.
zh: 一位電視上的魔術師聲稱自己有通靈能力，說他能讀出別人的心思，但科學家找不到任何證據。

en: Psychotherapy, which involves talking with a trained professional, can help people deal with stress and sadness.
zh: 心理治療是指和受過訓練的專業人員談話，能幫助人們面對壓力和悲傷。

en: Students made posters to publicize the charity concert and encourage more people to attend.
zh: 學生們製作海報來宣傳這場慈善音樂會，鼓勵更多人參加。

en: As the old train started to move, small puffs of smoke rose into the cold air.
zh: 當老火車開始移動時，一小陣一小陣的煙飄向寒冷的空中。

en: Our teacher is always punctual, arriving at exactly 8:00 every morning, never even a minute late.
zh: 我們老師總是很準時，每天早上八點整抵達，從來沒有遲到過一分鐘。

en: Sand and small stones can help purify water by trapping dirt as the water slowly passes through them.
zh: 沙子和小石頭可以在水慢慢流過時攔住髒污，藉此幫助淨化水。

en: Scientists tested the purity of the water to make sure it was clean and safe to drink.
zh: 科學家檢測水的純淨度，以確保水乾淨且可以安全飲用。

en: Suddenly the ground began to quake, and books fell from the shelves as the earthquake shook the building.
zh: 地面突然開始震動，地震搖晃大樓時，書本紛紛從書架上掉落。

en: A teaching qualification is required for anyone who wants to work as a teacher at a public school.
zh: 任何想在公立學校當老師的人都必須具備教師資格。

en: On her graduation day, Mia looked radiant, her face shining with happiness and pride.
zh: 畢業那天，Mia 容光煥發，臉上洋溢著喜悅與驕傲。

en: All night, the old stove radiated heat, keeping the small wooden house warm during the cold winter.
zh: 那座老火爐整夜散發熱氣，在寒冷的冬天讓小木屋保持溫暖。

en: Radioactive waste from nuclear power plants must be stored safely for thousands of years.
zh: 核電廠產生的放射性廢料必須被安全地存放數千年。

en: In Taiwan, white radishes are often cooked in soups, especially during the cold winter months.
zh: 在台灣，白蘿蔔常被拿來煮湯，尤其是在寒冷的冬季月份。

en: A circle's radius is the distance from its center to its edge, which is half the distance across it.
zh: 圓的半徑是從圓心到邊緣的距離，也就是直徑的一半。

en: Rap is a style of music in which performers speak words quickly over a strong beat.
zh: 饒舌是一種音樂風格，表演者在強烈的節拍上快速地唸出歌詞。

en: After eating shrimp, Ben developed a red rash on his arms and neck that made his skin hurt.
zh: 吃了蝦子之後，Ben 的手臂和脖子上起了紅疹，讓他的皮膚很不舒服。

en: An agreement will not take effect until all member countries ratify it and officially approve it.
zh: 協議要等到所有成員國都批准並正式同意後才會生效。

en: The realization that she had left her passport at home made Lisa panic at the airport.
zh: 意識到自己把護照忘在家裡，讓 Lisa 在機場驚慌失措。

en: Students who study regularly throughout the year will reap the rewards when exams come.
zh: 整年都規律讀書的學生，在考試來臨時就會收穫成果。

en: Reckless driving, such as speeding or using a phone while driving, causes many accidents every year.
zh: 魯莽駕駛，例如超速或開車時使用手機，每年都造成許多事故。

en: I reckon it will take us about two hours to reach the top of the mountain.
zh: 我估計我們大約要花兩個小時才能抵達山頂。

en: After weeks of not speaking, the two friends finally reconciled and laughed about their silly fight.
zh: 在好幾週互不說話之後，這兩個朋友終於和好了，還笑談那場愚蠢的爭吵。

en: This park offers many recreational activities, such as biking, swimming, and playing tennis.
zh: 這座公園提供許多休閒娛樂活動，例如騎單車、游泳和打網球。

en: Good writers avoid redundancy; for example, they write "gift" instead of "free gift," since gifts are always free.
zh: 好的作家會避免冗贅；例如，他們會寫「禮物」而不是「免費禮物」，因為禮物本來就是免費的。

en: Reefs in warm seas are home to thousands of kinds of fish, but rising ocean temperatures are damaging them.
zh: 溫暖海域的礁岩是數千種魚類的家園，但海水溫度上升正在破壞它們。

en: When a player fell to the ground, the referee blew the whistle and stopped the game.
zh: 當一名球員倒地時，裁判吹哨暫停了比賽。

en: In a referendum, citizens vote directly on an important question instead of leaving the decision to lawmakers.
zh: 在公投中，公民直接對重要議題投票，而不是把決定權交給立法者。

en: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel for cars and planes.
zh: 原油必須經過精煉，才能作為汽車和飛機的燃料。

en: Runners often wear reflective clothing at night so that drivers can see them clearly in the dark.
zh: 跑者在夜間常穿著反光衣物，讓駕駛在黑暗中也能清楚看見他們。

en: A short walk in fresh air can refresh your mind after hours of studying.
zh: 在讀了好幾個小時的書後，到戶外呼吸新鮮空氣、散步一下，能讓頭腦恢復清醒。

en: Light refreshments, including tea, coffee, and cookies, will be served after the lecture.
zh: 演講結束後將提供茶、咖啡和餅乾等簡單茶點。

en: Showing clear evidence, the scientist refuted the popular claim and proved that it was false.
zh: 這位科學家提出明確的證據，反駁了那個流行的說法，證明它是錯的。

en: After the accident, he spent months in the hospital as doctors helped rehabilitate his injured leg.
zh: 意外發生後，他在醫院待了好幾個月，醫生協助他受傷的腿復健。

en: For a whole month, the drama club rehearsed the play every afternoon before opening night.
zh: 首演之前的整整一個月，戲劇社每天下午都在排練這齣戲。

en: During the king's long reign of over fifty years, the country enjoyed peace and growing wealth.
zh: 在國王長達五十多年的統治期間，這個國家享有和平與日益增加的財富。

en: When the rain finally came after months of dry weather, the whole village rejoiced.
zh: 在乾旱了好幾個月之後終於下雨，全村都欣喜萬分。

en: Our class won the relay race, with each of the four runners running one part of the race.
zh: 我們班贏得了接力賽，四名跑者各跑一段賽程。

en: Despite the relentless rain, the volunteers kept working to clean up the beach.
zh: 儘管雨下個不停，志工們仍持續努力清理海灘。

en: Many countries are trying to reduce their reliance on oil from abroad by developing solar and wind power.
zh: 許多國家正藉由發展太陽能和風力發電，努力減少對外國石油的依賴。

en: Young children are reliant on their parents for food, safety, and love.
zh: 年幼的孩子在食物、安全和愛上都依賴父母。

en: Our city museum displays relics from an ancient city, including pots, coins, and tools.
zh: 我們的市立博物館展出一座古城的遺物，包括陶罐、錢幣和工具。

en: We spent the morning at the museum and the remainder of the day exploring the old market.
zh: 我們上午待在博物館，剩下的時間則去逛老市場。

en: The smell of the bread was reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen, bringing back happy childhood memories.
zh: 麵包的香味讓人聯想到奶奶的廚房，喚起了快樂的童年回憶。

en: Taipei is renowned for its night markets, where visitors from all over the world come to taste local snacks.
zh: 台北以夜市聞名，來自世界各地的遊客都會到那裡品嚐在地小吃。

en: Some plants reproduce by spreading seeds, while others grow new plants from their roots.
zh: 有些植物靠散播種子來繁殖，有些則從根部長出新的植株。

en: Like other reptiles, snakes and turtles cannot produce their own body heat, so they often lie in the sun.
zh: 和其他爬蟲類一樣，蛇和烏龜無法自己產生體熱，所以常常躺在陽光下。

en: Amy resented being treated like a child when her parents made every decision for her without asking.
zh: 父母總是不問 Amy 就替她做所有決定，她很不滿自己被當成小孩看待。

en: About two thirds of the island's people reside in big cities, while the rest live in the countryside.
zh: 這座島約三分之二的人口居住在大城市，其餘的人則住在鄉間。

en: Farmers prefer this new kind of rice because it is resistant to disease and can survive long dry periods.
zh: 農民偏愛這種新品種稻米，因為它能抵抗疾病，還能撐過長期乾旱。

en: After the meeting, the students returned to their respective classrooms to share the news with their own classmates.
zh: 會議結束後，學生們回到各自的教室，把消息告訴自己班上的同學。

en: The restoration of the old temple took five years, and workers carefully repaired every painted wall by hand.
zh: 這座老廟的修復工程花了五年，工人們親手細心修補每一面彩繪牆。

en: Lisa tried hard to restrain her laughter during the serious speech, but she finally burst out laughing.
zh: Lisa 在那場嚴肅的演講中努力忍住不笑，但最後還是忍不住大笑出來。

en: Doctors advise restraint when eating sweets, since too much sugar can harm both your teeth and your heart.
zh: 醫生建議吃甜食時要節制，因為吃太多糖會傷害牙齒和心臟。

en: When told that her plan would never work, Mia quickly retorted that nobody had even tried it yet.
zh: 有人說她的計畫絕對行不通，Mia 立刻反駁說根本還沒有人試過。

en: Trained dogs can retrieve balls thrown into the lake and bring them back to their owners.
zh: 受過訓練的狗能把丟進湖裡的球取回來，交還給主人。

en: The revelation that the famous painting was a fake shocked art lovers and museum experts alike.
zh: 那幅名畫竟是贗品的消息一經揭露，讓藝術愛好者和博物館專家都大為震驚。

en: Recent years have seen a revival of interest in traditional crafts, as young people learn to make paper umbrellas again.
zh: 近年來，大眾對傳統工藝的興趣再度復興，年輕人又開始學做紙傘。

en: A cup of hot tea and a short rest helped revive the tired students after their long climb.
zh: 一杯熱茶加上短暫休息，讓長途攀爬後疲憊的學生們恢復了精神。

en: In history class, we learned how farmers revolted against the heavy taxes of their king.
zh: 歷史課上，我們學到農民如何起來反抗國王沉重的稅收。

en: Just as the moon revolves around the Earth, the Earth travels around the sun once every year.
zh: 就像月球繞著地球運轉一樣，地球每年也繞著太陽運行一圈。

en: Before a new medicine reaches the market, it must pass rigorous tests that check both its safety and its effects.
zh: 新藥上市前，必須通過嚴格的測試，檢驗其安全性和療效。

en: When Ken threw a small stone into the pond, ripples spread out in circles across the calm water.
zh: Ken 把小石頭丟進池塘時，漣漪一圈圈地在平靜的水面上散開。

en: The friendly rivalry between the two schools pushes both basketball teams to practice harder every year.
zh: 兩校之間的友好競爭，促使兩支籃球隊每年都更加努力練習。

en: In this national park, wild deer roam freely through the forests, moving from place to place without fences.
zh: 在這座國家公園裡，野鹿在森林中自由漫遊，四處走動，沒有圍欄阻擋。

en: Thanks to daily exercise and healthy food, my grandfather is still robust and rarely gets sick at age eighty.
zh: 多虧每天運動和健康飲食，我爺爺八十歲了仍很健壯，很少生病。

en: Because the Earth rotates once every twenty-four hours, each place on it has both day and night.
zh: 由於地球每二十四小時自轉一圈，地球上的每個地方都有白天和黑夜。

en: Farmers use crop rotation, planting different crops in the same field each year, to keep the soil healthy.
zh: 農民採用輪作，也就是每年在同一塊田裡輪流種不同的作物，讓土壤保持健康。

en: Visitors to the palace can see the rooms where royalty once lived, including the beds of kings and queens.
zh: 參觀宮殿的遊客可以看到皇室成員曾經居住的房間，包括國王和王后的床。

en: Volunteers spent the whole morning picking up plastic bags, bottles, and other rubbish from the beach.
zh: 志工們花了一整個早上，在海灘上撿拾塑膠袋、瓶子和其他垃圾。

en: Full of sharp rocks and steep climbs, the rugged mountain path was a real challenge for the young students.
zh: 這條崎嶇的山路布滿尖石和陡坡，對年輕的學生們來說是一大挑戰。

en: In the novel, the ruthless businessman shows no pity as he forces poor families out of their homes.
zh: 在這本小說裡，那位冷酷無情的商人毫無憐憫地把窮苦人家趕出家門。

en: At the start of the ceremony, the soldiers raised their right hands to salute the national flag.
zh: 典禮開始時，士兵們舉起右手向國旗敬禮。

en: Neighbors managed to salvage a few old books and photos from the burning house before the roof fell in.
zh: 鄰居們在屋頂塌下前，設法從燃燒的房子裡搶救出幾本舊書和照片。

en: Clean water and good sanitation, like public toilets and waste systems, help stop the spread of disease in cities.
zh: 乾淨的水和良好的衛生設施，例如公共廁所和廢棄物處理系統，有助於阻止疾病在城市中傳播。

en: In old stories, the wolf is often shown as a savage animal that attacks without reason.
zh: 在古老的故事裡，狼常被描寫成會無緣無故攻擊的野蠻動物。

en: We took the scenic road along the coast, stopping often to enjoy the beautiful views of the ocean.
zh: 我們走沿海那條風景優美的道路，常常停下來欣賞美麗的海景。

en: Many early scientists faced scorn from others, who laughed at their ideas before later accepting them.
zh: 許多早期的科學家都曾遭受他人的輕蔑，人們先是嘲笑他們的想法，後來才接受。

en: Ben fell off his bike and scraped his knee on the rough road, but it was only a small cut.
zh: Ben 從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋在粗糙的路面上擦傷了，不過只是個小傷口。

en: To fix the loose door handle, Dad used a screwdriver to tighten the small screws.
zh: 為了修理鬆掉的門把，爸爸用螺絲起子把小螺絲鎖緊。

en: The museum displays an ancient Chinese scroll, a long roll of paper painted with mountains and rivers.
zh: 博物館展出一幅中國古代的卷軸，那是一長卷畫著山水的紙。

en: Every claim in the science report came under close scrutiny, as experts carefully checked each number.
zh: 這份科學報告中的每項說法都受到仔細檢查，專家們逐一核對每個數字。

en: Working with hammers and stone, a local sculptor spent three years creating the huge statue in the city park.
zh: 一位在地雕刻家用槌子和石頭工作了三年，完成了市立公園裡的巨大雕像。

en: Hungry seagulls followed the fishing boats into the harbor, hoping to catch small fish thrown into the sea.
zh: 飢餓的海鷗跟著漁船進港，希望能抓到被丟進海裡的小魚。

en: Shops use bright lights and sweet smells to seduce customers into buying things they do not really need.
zh: 商店利用明亮的燈光和香甜的氣味，引誘顧客購買他們其實不需要的東西。

en: Instead of reading everything online, smart students are selective and choose only reliable sources of information.
zh: 聰明的學生不會什麼網路資料都看，而是有所選擇，只挑可靠的資訊來源。

en: Far from the noisy city, the lake was serene, with only the soft songs of birds breaking the silence.
zh: 遠離喧鬧的城市，湖畔一片寧靜，只有輕柔的鳥鳴打破沉默。

en: Before becoming a teacher, my grandfather served as a sergeant in the army, leading a small group of soldiers.
zh: 我爺爺在當老師之前，曾在陸軍擔任中士，帶領一小隊士兵。

en: The writer's new story first appeared as a serial, with one chapter printed in the magazine each week.
zh: 這位作家的新故事最初是以連載的形式刊出，每週在雜誌上登一章。

en: Every Sunday, the priest gives a sermon, teaching the people in the church to be kind and forgive others.
zh: 每週日，神父都會布道，教導教堂裡的人要仁慈、要寬恕他人。

en: Experts suggest eating five servings of fruit and vegetables a day; one serving equals about one apple.
zh: 專家建議每天吃五份蔬果；一份大約等於一顆蘋果。

en: Losing the first game was a setback for the team, but they kept trying and won the next three.
zh: 輸掉第一場比賽對球隊而言是個挫折，但他們繼續努力，接下來連贏三場。

en: Although his coat was shabby, with holes in both sleeves, the old man always kept it clean and neat.
zh: 那位老先生的外套雖然破舊，兩邊袖子都有破洞，但他總是保持乾淨整齊。

en: Before the drawing class, Amy used a small knife to sharpen her pencils to a fine point.
zh: 美術課前，Amy 用小刀把鉛筆削得很尖。

en: My father uses an electric shaver every morning because it is faster and safer than a blade.
zh: 我爸爸每天早上都用電動刮鬍刀，因為它比刀片更快也更安全。

en: Everyone has shortcomings, but wise people admit their faults and work hard to improve them.
zh: 每個人都有缺點，但聰明人會承認自己的不足，並努力改進。

en: Cutting down the forest for quick profit is shortsighted, because the land will soon become poor and empty.
zh: 為了快速獲利而砍伐森林是很短視的，因為這片土地很快就會變得貧瘠荒蕪。

en: Mom cut the cabbage into thin shreds and mixed them with carrots to make a fresh salad.
zh: 媽媽把高麗菜切成細絲，和紅蘿蔔拌在一起做成新鮮沙拉。

en: When a large spider dropped onto her desk, Lisa let out a loud shriek and jumped out of her chair.
zh: 一隻大蜘蛛掉到她桌上時，Lisa 發出一聲尖叫，從椅子上跳了起來。

en: Small shrubs, which are shorter than trees, were planted along the path to give the garden more green.
zh: 步道旁種了比樹木矮的小灌木，讓花園多些綠意。

en: Before each round of the card game, Kevin shuffled the cards carefully so that no one could guess their order.
zh: 每一輪紙牌遊戲開始前，Kevin 都會仔細洗牌，讓沒人能猜到牌的順序。

en: On hot summer afternoons, Grandma closes the wooden shutters to keep the hot sun out of the living room.
zh: 炎熱的夏日午後，奶奶會關上木製百葉窗，擋住照進客廳的陽光。

en: Many people love the simplicity of Japanese homes, which have few decorations and plain, open spaces.
zh: 許多人喜愛日式住宅的簡單，屋內裝飾很少，空間樸素而開闊。

en: To help young students understand, the teacher simplified the science lesson by using easy words and pictures.
zh: 為了幫助年幼的學生理解，老師用簡單的字詞和圖片簡化了這堂自然課。

en: The speech was given in English, with simultaneous translation into Chinese so listeners could follow it at the same time.
zh: 這場演講以英文進行，並提供同步中文口譯，讓聽眾能同時理解內容。

en: Many scientists were skeptical of the new claim, doubting it until they saw more evidence.
zh: 許多科學家對這項新說法抱持懷疑，在看到更多證據之前都不相信。

en: Instead of reading every word, try to skim the article first to get a general idea of its main points.
zh: 與其逐字閱讀，不如先略讀文章，大致掌握它的重點。

en: Slang changes so quickly that words popular among students today may sound old and strange in ten years.
zh: 俚語變化得很快，今天在學生間流行的用語，十年後可能聽起來既過時又奇怪。

en: Facing a drop in sales, the company slashed its prices by half to attract more customers.
zh: 面對銷售量下滑，這家公司將價格大砍一半以吸引更多顧客。

en: In the 1800s, the slaughter of millions of buffalo by hunters almost caused the animals to disappear from North America.
zh: 在十九世紀，獵人大量屠殺數百萬頭野牛，幾乎使這種動物從北美洲消失。

en: In the old legend, a brave young knight slays a dragon to save the village.
zh: 在古老的傳說裡，一位勇敢的年輕騎士殺死惡龍，拯救了村莊。

en: Ben's report was returned because his sloppy handwriting and many spelling mistakes made it hard for the teacher to read.
zh: Ben 的報告被退回，因為他字跡潦草又有很多拼字錯誤，老師很難看懂。

en: Millions of people around the world live in slums, crowded areas with poor housing and no clean water.
zh: 全世界有數百萬人住在貧民窟，那裡擁擠不堪，房屋簡陋，也沒有乾淨的水。

en: During the long rainy season, ice cream sales slumped, falling to half of their usual level.
zh: 漫長的雨季期間，冰淇淋的銷售量暴跌，只剩平常的一半。

en: In many old stories, the fox is a sly animal that tricks others to get what it wants.
zh: 在許多古老故事中，狐狸是一種狡猾的動物，會耍詐騙別人來得到想要的東西。

en: Customs officers at the airport caught a man trying to smuggle rare birds into the country in his bag.
zh: 機場海關人員逮到一名男子，他企圖把稀有鳥類藏在包包裡走私入境。

en: Since we will walk a lot during the school trip, please wear comfortable sneakers instead of leather shoes.
zh: 校外教學時會走很多路，所以請穿舒適的運動鞋，不要穿皮鞋。

en: Kevin made a sneaky move, quietly taking the last cookie while everyone else was looking away.
zh: Kevin 鬼鬼祟祟地趁大家看別處時，悄悄拿走了最後一塊餅乾。

en: Pepper in the air made Amy sneeze three times, so she quickly covered her nose with a tissue.
zh: 空氣中的胡椒讓 Amy 打了三個噴嚏，她趕緊用面紙遮住鼻子。

en: My brother snores so loudly at night that the noise sometimes keeps the whole family awake.
zh: 我哥哥晚上打鼾聲音大到有時讓全家人都睡不著。

en: Lisa is very sociable; she loves meeting new people and is always chatting with someone at parties.
zh: Lisa 很好交際，她喜歡認識新朋友，在派對上總是在跟人聊天。

en: In history class, we compared socialism, which supports public control of major industries, with free market systems.
zh: 歷史課上，我們比較了主張主要產業由公眾掌控的社會主義和自由市場制度。

en: As a socialist, the nineteenth-century writer believed that factories should belong to the workers, not to a few rich owners.
zh: 這位十九世紀的作家身為社會主義者，認為工廠應該屬於工人，而不是少數富有的老闆。

en: Joining a club gives shy students a chance to socialize and make friends outside of class.
zh: 參加社團讓害羞的學生有機會與人交際，在課堂外交到朋友。

en: In sociology, students study how people live in groups, from families to schools to entire cities.
zh: 在社會學中，學生研究人們如何在群體中生活，從家庭、學校到整座城市。

en: The ceremony was solemn and quiet, as everyone stood in silence to remember the people lost in the earthquake.
zh: 典禮莊嚴而安靜，大家默立追念在地震中罹難的人們。

en: After the typhoon, people across Taiwan showed solidarity by sending food, water, and money to the victims.
zh: 颱風過後，全台灣的人展現團結，捐贈食物、水和金錢給災民。

en: While lions live in groups, tigers are solitary animals that usually hunt alone.
zh: 獅子是群居的，老虎則是獨居動物，通常單獨狩獵。

en: After a busy week, Mia enjoys the solitude of a quiet walk in the woods, away from everyone.
zh: 忙碌了一週後，Mia 喜歡獨自在樹林裡安靜散步，遠離所有人，享受獨處的時光。

en: Singing a soft song, the young mother tried to soothe her crying baby until he finally fell asleep.
zh: 年輕的媽媽唱著輕柔的歌，試著安撫哭鬧的寶寶，直到他終於睡著。

en: This old song tells a sorrowful story about a girl waiting for her father to return from the sea.
zh: 這首老歌講述一個悲傷的故事，關於一個女孩等待父親從海上歸來。

en: In the past, the sovereign of a country had the power to make laws and collect taxes.
zh: 在過去，一國的君主擁有制定法律和徵收稅金的權力。

en: In 1969, the spacecraft Apollo 11 carried three men to the moon and safely brought them back to Earth.
zh: 1969年，阿波羅11號太空船載著三名太空人前往月球，並平安將他們送回地球。

en: Over a span of fifty years, the small fishing village grew into a busy city with tall buildings.
zh: 在五十年的期間裡，這個小漁村發展成高樓林立的繁忙城市。

en: A small brown sparrow landed near the window, eating the rice that Grandma had left there for birds.
zh: 一隻棕色的小麻雀停在窗邊，吃著奶奶留給鳥兒的米粒。

en: On New Year's Eve, the fireworks over Taipei 101 create an amazing spectacle for thousands of people watching below.
zh: 跨年夜時，台北101上空的煙火為底下數千名觀眾呈現壯觀的奇景。

en: A snail's shell grows in a spiral, curling around and around as it moves out from the center.
zh: 蝸牛殼呈螺旋狀生長，從中心一圈又一圈地向外捲。

en: Tourists were amazed by the splendor of the palace, with its golden roofs and huge, colorful halls.
zh: 遊客們對宮殿的壯麗驚嘆不已，那裡有金色的屋頂和巨大華麗的大廳。

en: A spokesperson for the hospital told reporters that the patients were in stable condition.
zh: 醫院的發言人告訴記者，病患的情況穩定。

en: Nobody planned it, but when the singer finished, the crowd broke into spontaneous applause and cheering.
zh: 沒有人事先安排，但歌手唱完時，群眾自發地爆出熱烈的掌聲和歡呼。

en: A true sportsman shakes hands with the other team after the game, whether he wins or loses.
zh: 真正的運動員在比賽結束後，不論輸贏都會和對手握手。

en: Even after losing the final, the players showed great sportsmanship by congratulating the winners warmly.
zh: 即使輸掉了決賽，球員們仍展現出高度的運動家精神，熱情地向優勝者道賀。

en: Standing in the spotlight on stage, Amy felt nervous as hundreds of eyes turned toward her.
zh: Amy 站在舞台的聚光燈下，數百雙眼睛朝她看過來，她感到很緊張。

en: Winning a small prize spurred Kevin to study even harder for the science competition.
zh: 贏得一個小獎項激勵了 Kevin 更加努力準備科學競賽。

en: Doctors gave the patient medicine to stabilize her heart rate, which had been dangerously fast.
zh: 醫生給病人用藥，以穩定她快到危險程度的心跳速率。

en: Exhausted after the marathon, the runner staggered across the finish line and fell onto the grass.
zh: 跑完馬拉松後精疲力盡，那位跑者搖搖晃晃地越過終點線，倒在草地上。

en: Lisa put a staple in the corner of her report to keep the pages together before handing it in.
zh: Lisa 在報告角落釘了一根釘書針，把各頁固定在一起後才交出去。

en: During the long winter, many wild animals die of starvation because food is so hard to find.
zh: 漫長的冬季裡，許多野生動物因為很難找到食物而餓死。

en: Benjamin Franklin is remembered as a scientist, a writer, and a wise statesman who helped build the United States.
zh: 班傑明・富蘭克林被人們記得是一位科學家、作家，也是協助建立美國的睿智政治家。

en: Because a fallen tree blocked the road, our bus remained stationary for twenty minutes without moving at all.
zh: 由於倒下的樹擋住了道路，我們的公車停在原地二十分鐘，完全沒有移動。

en: Before school starts, Amy buys stationery such as pens, notebooks, rulers, and erasers at the local bookstore.
zh: 開學前，Amy 會到附近的書店買文具，像是筆、筆記本、尺和橡皮擦。

en: Although small in stature, the basketball player could jump higher than most of the taller players on his team.
zh: 雖然身材矮小，這名籃球員卻能跳得比大多數比他高的隊友還高。

en: According to the statute, all drivers and passengers must wear seat belts while the car is moving.
zh: 根據法令，車子行駛時所有駕駛和乘客都必須繫上安全帶。

en: After marrying a woman with a young son, Mr. Lin treated his stepchild just like his own child.
zh: 林先生娶了一位帶著年幼兒子的女士後，待繼子就像自己的孩子一樣。

en: Mia's stepfather, who married her mother two years ago, helps her with math homework every night.
zh: Mia 的繼父兩年前和她母親結婚，每天晚上都會幫她做數學作業。

en: In the story of Cinderella, the girl's stepmother makes her clean the house while her own daughters rest.
zh: 在灰姑娘的故事裡，繼母讓女孩打掃房子，自己的女兒們卻在休息。

en: Babies need plenty of stimulation, such as colorful toys, music, and gentle talking, to help their brains develop.
zh: 嬰兒需要充分的刺激，例如色彩鮮豔的玩具、音樂和輕柔的話語，來幫助大腦發育。

en: About 14 kilometers wide at its narrowest point, the Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
zh: 直布羅陀海峽最窄處約14公里寬，連接大西洋與地中海。

en: If they are not controlled, some climbing plants can strangle young trees by wrapping tightly around their trunks.
zh: 若不加以控制，有些攀緣植物會緊緊纏繞幼樹的樹幹，把它們勒死。

en: Lisa often feeds the stray cats in her neighborhood, which have no owners and live on the streets.
zh: Lisa 常餵附近的流浪貓，牠們沒有主人，住在街頭。

en: Medical science has made great strides in fighting cancer over the past few decades.
zh: 過去幾十年來，醫學在對抗癌症方面已有長足的進展。

en: After dinner, my grandparents like to take a slow stroll along the river to enjoy the cool evening air.
zh: 晚餐後，我的祖父母喜歡沿著河邊慢慢散步，享受傍晚涼爽的空氣。

en: Everyone was stunned when the quiet student won first prize in the national contest; no one had expected it.
zh: 那位安靜的學生在全國比賽中奪得第一名時，大家都很震驚；沒有人料到會這樣。

en: As a child, Ken had a stutter and often repeated sounds, but speech lessons helped him talk smoothly.
zh: Ken 小時候有口吃，常常重複某些音，但說話課程幫助他能流暢地說話。

en: Lisa always looks stylish in her simple but fashionable clothes, and her friends often ask her for advice.
zh: Lisa 穿著簡單卻時髦的衣服，總是看起來很有型，朋友們常向她請教穿搭。

en: Taste in art is subjective; a painting that one person loves may seem boring to someone else.
zh: 藝術品味是主觀的；某個人喜愛的畫作，在另一個人看來可能很無聊。

en: A good manager listens to the ideas of her subordinates instead of simply giving them orders.
zh: 好的主管會聆聽下屬的想法，而不是只對他們下命令。

en: Many students subscribe to online science channels so that they get new videos as soon as they come out.
zh: 許多學生訂閱線上科學頻道，好在新影片一推出就收到。

en: Amy's grandmother gave her a one-year subscription to a nature magazine, so a new copy arrives every month.
zh: Amy 的奶奶送她一年份的自然雜誌訂閱，所以每個月都會寄來一本新的。

en: To encourage clean energy, the government subsidizes families who put solar panels on their roofs, paying part of the cost.
zh: 為了鼓勵使用乾淨能源，政府補貼在屋頂裝設太陽能板的家庭，替他們支付部分費用。

en: Our team won five games in succession, beating one school after another without a single loss.
zh: 我們隊伍連續贏了五場比賽，一所接著一所地擊敗對手，一場也沒輸。

en: For the third successive year, the small town was named the cleanest place in the country.
zh: 這個小鎮連續第三年被評為全國最乾淨的地方。

en: Plastic bags are dangerous to young children, who could suffocate if a bag covers their face.
zh: 塑膠袋對幼童很危險，萬一袋子蓋住臉，他們可能會窒息。

en: Before the trip, Mia packed her suitcase with clothes, shoes, and a camera, but it was too heavy to lift.
zh: 出發前，Mia 把衣服、鞋子和相機裝進行李箱，結果重到提不起來。

en: The principal summoned all the class leaders to her office for an urgent meeting about the school festival.
zh: 校長把所有班長召集到她的辦公室，就校慶開緊急會議。

en: Judging people by their looks is superficial, since appearance tells us little about someone's true character.
zh: 以貌取人是膚淺的，因為外表很難讓我們看出一個人真正的品格。

en: When the heater broke, the building superintendent, who manages repairs for every apartment, fixed it within an hour.
zh: 暖氣壞掉時，負責管理每戶修繕的大樓主管在一小時內就修好了。

en: Cats have a clear superiority over humans in seeing at night, since their eyes collect much more light.
zh: 貓在夜間視力方面明顯優於人類，因為牠們的眼睛能收集更多光線。

en: Some superstitious people believe that breaking a mirror will bring seven years of bad luck.
zh: 有些迷信的人相信打破鏡子會帶來七年的厄運。

en: Doctors say vitamin pills should only supplement a healthy diet, not replace real food.
zh: 醫生說維他命丸只應用來補充健康飲食，而不能取代真正的食物。

en: Lisa tried to suppress a yawn during the long meeting, but she could not hide how tired she was.
zh: Lisa 在冗長的會議中試圖忍住哈欠，卻藏不住自己有多累。

en: There was a sudden surge in the number of visitors to the beach when the summer vacation began.
zh: 暑假一開始，海灘的遊客人數突然激增。

en: Doctors and nurses wear surgical masks and gloves during operations to protect patients from germs.
zh: 醫生和護理師在手術時戴外科口罩和手套，保護病人免受細菌感染。

en: In Taiwan, Chen, Lin, and Wang are among the most common surnames, used by millions of families.
zh: 在台灣，陳、林、王都是最常見的姓氏之一，有數百萬個家庭使用。

en: By the age of twelve, the young chess player had already surpassed her teacher and won several national titles.
zh: 這名年輕的棋手十二歲時就已超越她的老師，並贏得多項全國冠軍。

en: Full of suspense, this mystery novel keeps readers guessing who stole the jewels until the very last page.
zh: 這本推理小說充滿懸疑，讓讀者直到最後一頁都在猜是誰偷了珠寶。

en: Because of the heavy snow, the city announced the suspension of all bus services until the roads were cleared.
zh: 由於大雪，市政府宣布暫停所有公車服務，直到道路清理完畢。

en: Many birds, frogs, and insects live in the swamp, a wet, muddy area covered with water and tall grass.
zh: 許多鳥類、青蛙和昆蟲都生活在沼澤裡，那是一片覆蓋著水和高草、潮濕泥濘的地區。

en: A huge swarm of bees, thousands of them flying together, suddenly appeared over the farm and frightened the workers.
zh: 一大群蜜蜂，數以千計地一起飛行，突然出現在農場上空，嚇壞了工人們。

en: In Chinese culture, the color red symbolizes good luck and joy, so it is used at weddings and New Year.
zh: 在華人文化中，紅色象徵好運與喜慶，所以常用在婚禮和新年。

en: A butterfly's wings show perfect symmetry, with the left side looking exactly like the right side.
zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀呈現完美的對稱，左邊看起來和右邊一模一樣。

en: I can sympathize with Amy because I also felt lonely when I moved to a new school.
zh: 我很同情 Amy 的處境，因為我轉到新學校時也覺得很孤單。

en: Last night, the city orchestra performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony, a long musical work with four parts.
zh: 昨晚，市立管弦樂團演出了貝多芬的第九號交響曲，這是一部有四個樂章的長篇音樂作品。

en: "Glad" is a synonym of "happy" because both words have almost the same meaning in most situations.
zh: 「glad」是「happy」的同義詞，因為這兩個字在大多數情況下意思幾乎相同。

en: While cotton and wool come from nature, many sports clothes are made of synthetic materials produced in factories.
zh: 棉和羊毛來自大自然，而許多運動服則是用工廠生產的合成材料製成。

en: For breakfast, Ken poured sweet syrup made from sugar and water over his pancakes.
zh: 早餐時，Ken 把用糖和水熬成的甜糖漿淋在鬆餅上。

en: After a week at the beach, Mia came home with a deep tan on her arms and face.
zh: 在海邊待了一個星期，Mia 回家時手臂和臉都曬得黝黑。

en: Copying the same sentence a hundred times was a tedious task, and Ben soon became bored and sleepy.
zh: 把同一個句子抄一百遍是件冗長乏味的工作，Ben 很快就覺得無聊又想睡。

en: Modern telecommunications, such as cell phones and the Internet, allow people to talk across the world instantly.
zh: 現代電信，例如手機和網際網路，讓人們能即時與世界各地的人通話。

en: At the bank, the teller counted the money carefully before handing it to the customer.
zh: 在銀行裡，出納員把錢仔細數過之後才交給顧客。

en: The song starts at a slow tempo, but the beat becomes faster and faster as it reaches the end.
zh: 這首歌一開始速度很慢，但接近尾聲時節拍越來越快。

en: Each month, the tenants of the apartment pay rent to the owner, who also repairs anything broken.
zh: 這棟公寓的房客每個月付房租給屋主，屋主也負責修理任何損壞的東西。

en: Our class made a tentative plan to visit the museum on Friday, but the date may still change.
zh: 我們班暫定星期五去參觀博物館，但日期可能還會變動。

en: Farmers in the mountains grow rice on terraces, which are flat steps cut into the sides of hills.
zh: 山區的農民在梯田上種稻，梯田是在山坡上開闢出來的一階階平地。

en: In this textile factory, machines turn raw cotton into cloth that is later made into shirts and towels.
zh: 在這間紡織工廠裡，機器把原棉製成布料，之後再做成襯衫和毛巾。

en: Mia joined the art club in her first year and won a prize shortly thereafter, just two months later.
zh: Mia 高一時加入美術社，此後不久，僅僅兩個月，就得了獎。

en: When Ken felt hot and weak, his mother used a thermometer to check whether he had a fever.
zh: Ken 覺得全身發燙又無力，媽媽就用溫度計量量看他是否發燒。

en: Because the Earth is tilted, different parts of it receive different amounts of heat from the sun, creating the seasons.
zh: 由於地球傾斜，地球的不同地區從太陽接收到的熱量不同，因而形成季節。

en: To avoid waking her sleeping baby brother, Amy walked into the room on tiptoe.
zh: 為了不吵醒熟睡的弟弟，Amy 踮著腳尖走進房間。

en: Listening to the same complaints every day became tiresome, and Lisa finally asked her friend to talk about something else.
zh: 每天聽同樣的抱怨變得令人厭煩，Lisa 最後請朋友換個話題。

en: Ken gave his teacher a card as a token of his thanks for her help during the year.
zh: Ken 送老師一張卡片，作為感謝她這一年來幫忙的心意。

en: A tornado is a violent, spinning column of air that can destroy houses in just a few seconds.
zh: 龍捲風是一股猛烈旋轉的空氣柱，短短幾秒內就能摧毀房屋。

en: After days of heavy rain, the small stream turned into a torrent that carried rocks and trees down the mountain.
zh: 連下好幾天大雨後，那條小溪變成了激流，把石頭和樹木沖下山。

en: A trademark, such as a special name or picture, shows that a product comes from a certain company.
zh: 商標，例如特定的名稱或圖案，用來表示某項產品出自某家公司。

en: When applying to universities, students must send their high school transcripts showing all their grades.
zh: 申請大學時，學生必須寄出列有所有成績的高中成績單。

en: Some mosquitoes transmit diseases, passing them from one person to another when they bite.
zh: 有些蚊子會傳染疾病，在叮咬時把病從一個人傳給另一個人。

en: After waiting two years, the patient finally received a heart transplant, replacing his weak heart with a healthy one.
zh: 等了兩年後，這名病人終於接受心臟移植，用一顆健康的心臟取代他衰弱的心臟。

en: This old library is a treasury of knowledge, holding thousands of rare books and ancient maps.
zh: 這座古老的圖書館是知識的寶庫，收藏著數千本珍本書和古地圖。

en: Carrying heavy bags, the students made a three-day trek through the mountains, walking over fifteen kilometers a day.
zh: 學生們背著沉重的背包，在山中長途跋涉三天，每天走超過十五公里。

en: Don't get upset over a trifle like a broken pencil; it is not worth worrying about.
zh: 別為了一枝斷掉的鉛筆這種小事生氣，那不值得煩惱。

en: Scientists estimate that the human body contains about 30 trillion cells, each with its own job.
zh: 科學家估計，人體約含有30兆個細胞，每個細胞各有其功能。

en: Many colorful birds and plants live in the tropics, the warm areas around the middle of the Earth.
zh: 許多色彩繽紛的鳥類和植物生活在熱帶，也就是赤道附近的溫暖地區。

en: Trout are fish that live in cold, clean rivers, so finding them is a sign of healthy water.
zh: 鱒魚是生活在寒冷、潔淨河流中的魚，因此能找到牠們就表示水質良好。

en: As a trustee of the museum, Mrs. Chen helps decide how donated money should be used.
zh: 陳女士身為博物館的董事，協助決定捐款該如何使用。

en: Ben tucked his shirt into his pants before the school photo so that he would look neat.
zh: 拍學校團體照前，Ben 把襯衫塞進褲子裡，讓自己看起來整齊一點。

en: Moving to a new city left Amy's mind in turmoil, full of worry and confusion about her future.
zh: 搬到新城市讓 Amy 心裡一片混亂，對未來充滿擔憂和困惑。

en: At twilight, after the sun has set but before the sky is completely dark, bats come out to hunt insects.
zh: 黃昏時分，太陽已下山但天空還沒完全變黑，蝙蝠便出來捕食昆蟲。

en: On clear nights far from city lights, we could see thousands of stars twinkling in the sky.
zh: 在遠離城市燈光的晴朗夜晚，我們能看到成千上萬顆星星在天空中閃爍。

en: All thirty students agreed to visit the science museum, so the decision was unanimous.
zh: 全班三十位同學都同意去參觀科學博物館，所以這是全體一致通過的決定。

en: A parent's love is often described as unconditional because it does not depend on what the child does.
zh: 父母的愛常被形容為無條件的，因為它不取決於孩子做了什麼。

en: Never underestimate small insects; ants can carry objects many times heavier than their own bodies.
zh: 千萬別低估小昆蟲；螞蟻能搬起比自己身體重好幾倍的東西。

en: Lisa finally found her missing earring underneath the sofa, hidden beneath a pile of dust.
zh: Lisa 終於在沙發底下找到她遺失的耳環，就藏在一堆灰塵下面。

en: For safety, students should use the underpass, a passage under the road, instead of running across the busy street.
zh: 為了安全，學生應該走地下道，也就是道路下方的通道，而不是跑步穿越繁忙的街道。

en: Work on the new subway line is already underway and is expected to be finished in three years.
zh: 新捷運路線的工程已在進行中，預計三年後完工。

en: In 1990, the unification of East and West Germany created a single country after more than forty years apart.
zh: 1990年，東西德統一，在分隔四十多年後成為單一國家。

en: Long ago, the first emperor of China unified the different kingdoms and made them use the same system of writing.
zh: 很久以前，中國第一位皇帝統一了各個國家，並讓它們使用同一套文字。

en: In front of a cheering crowd, the mayor unveiled the poet's statue by pulling away the cloth covering it.
zh: 在歡呼的群眾面前，市長拉下覆蓋在詩人雕像上的布，為雕像揭幕。

en: Sit upright with your back straight instead of bending over your desk, or you may get neck pain.
zh: 坐的時候要挺直背部，不要彎腰趴在書桌上，否則可能會脖子痛。

en: In history class, students learned about a farmers' uprising in which thousands of people rose up against a cruel ruler.
zh: 歷史課上，學生學到一場農民起義，數千人起身反抗殘暴的統治者。

en: Housing prices have shown an upward trend, rising steadily for the past ten years.
zh: 房價呈現上升趨勢，過去十年來穩定上漲。

en: As the hot air balloon was filled, it slowly floated upward, rising high above the green fields.
zh: 熱氣球充飽氣後，緩緩向上飄升，高高升到綠色田野的上空。

en: Scientists stress the urgency of cutting carbon pollution, warning that time is running out to slow global warming.
zh: 科學家強調減少碳汙染的急迫性，警告減緩全球暖化的時間所剩無幾。

en: Just before the concert began, a staff member ushered us through the dark hall to our seats.
zh: 音樂會即將開始前，一位工作人員帶我們穿過昏暗的走道，到我們的座位。

en: Chopsticks, spoons, and other kitchen utensils hang on the wall so the cook can reach them easily.
zh: 筷子、湯匙和其他廚房器具掛在牆上，方便廚師隨手取用。

en: Our picnic was an utter failure; it rained all day, and we forgot the food at home.
zh: 我們的野餐徹底失敗了：整天下雨，而且我們還把食物忘在家裡。

en: Getting a flu vaccine every year helps protect older people from serious disease during winter.
zh: 每年接種流感疫苗有助於保護長者在冬季免於罹患重病。

en: Lisa added a few drops of vanilla to the cake mix, filling the kitchen with a sweet smell.
zh: Lisa 在蛋糕糊裡加了幾滴香草精，讓廚房充滿甜甜的香味。

en: Out of vanity, the young man spent all his money on expensive clothes just to impress others.
zh: 出於虛榮心，那個年輕人把所有錢都花在昂貴的衣服上，只為了讓別人刮目相看。

en: When water boils, it turns into vapor, which rises into the air as a gas.
zh: 水煮沸時會變成蒸氣，以氣體的形式升到空氣中。

en: At traditional weddings in many countries, the bride wears a white veil that covers her face.
zh: 在許多國家的傳統婚禮上，新娘會戴著遮住臉的白色面紗。

en: Covered in soft red velvet, the seats of the old theater feel smooth and warm to the touch.
zh: 這座老劇院的座椅覆蓋著柔軟的紅色天鵝絨，摸起來光滑又溫暖。

en: Eggs are a versatile food; you can boil them, fry them, or use them to bake cakes.
zh: 蛋是一種用途很廣的食物；可以水煮、油煎，或用來烤蛋糕。

en: When our cat stopped eating, we took her to the veterinarian, who found a small bone stuck in her throat.
zh: 我們的貓不吃東西時，我們帶牠去看獸醫，獸醫發現牠喉嚨裡卡了一小根骨頭。

en: Although most students liked the plan, the principal used her veto and said no to the beach trip.
zh: 雖然大多數學生喜歡這個計畫，校長卻行使否決權，不准去海邊旅行。

en: When a guitar string is played, it vibrates back and forth very quickly, which produces the sound we hear.
zh: 吉他弦被彈奏時會快速地來回振動，因而產生我們聽到的聲音。

en: Elephants can sense the vibration of the ground through their feet, which helps them notice others far away.
zh: 大象能透過腳感受到地面的振動，這幫助牠們察覺遠方的同伴。

en: My grandfather says that being lazy is the worst vice, since it keeps people from reaching their goals.
zh: 爺爺說懶惰是最糟的惡習，因為它讓人無法達成目標。

en: After a long and close match, the young player finally emerged as the victor and raised the trophy.
zh: 經過一場漫長又激烈的比賽，那名年輕選手終於成為勝利者，高舉獎盃。

en: Even at seventy, Grandpa works in his garden with great vigor, full of energy from morning to night.
zh: 爺爺即使七十歲了，仍精力充沛地在花園裡工作，從早到晚活力十足。

en: Doctors recommend at least thirty minutes of vigorous exercise, such as running or swimming, several times a week.
zh: 醫生建議每週數次、每次至少做三十分鐘的劇烈運動，例如跑步或游泳。

en: Every summer, the rich family stays in a large villa by the sea, with its own pool and garden.
zh: 每年夏天，那個富有的家庭都會住在海邊的大別墅，那裡有自己的游泳池和花園。

en: In most fairy tales, the villain is punished at the end, while the good characters live happily ever after.
zh: 在大多數童話故事裡，反派最後都會受到懲罰，而好人則從此過著幸福快樂的日子。

en: Grapes grow on vines, long climbing plants that wrap around poles or fences as they grow.
zh: 葡萄長在藤蔓上，那是一種長長的攀緣植物，生長時會纏繞在桿子或籬笆上。

en: Rows of grapes covered the hills of the vineyard, where workers picked the fruit by hand each autumn.
zh: 葡萄園的山坡上種滿一排排葡萄，每年秋天工人們都會用手採收果實。

en: Before performing with the city orchestra, the young violinist practiced her violin for six hours a day.
zh: 這位年輕的小提琴家在與市立管弦樂團演出前，每天練琴六個小時。

en: Much of the island is covered with virgin forest, land that has never been cut or changed by humans.
zh: 這座島上大部分覆蓋著原始森林，也就是從未被人類砍伐或改變過的土地。

en: After a week of rest by the sea, Mia returned to school full of vitality and fresh energy.
zh: 在海邊休息一週後，Mia 回到學校時充滿活力，精神煥發。

en: Teaching is not just a job for Ms. Wang; it is her vocation, the work she was born to do.
zh: 對王老師來說，教書不只是一份工作，而是她的使命，是她生來就該做的事。

en: Vocational schools teach practical skills, such as cooking, car repair, and computer design, to help students find jobs.
zh: 職業學校教授實用技能，例如烹飪、汽車維修和電腦設計，幫助學生找到工作。

en: In English, the letters a, e, i, o, and u are vowels, and every word usually has at least one.
zh: 在英文中，a、e、i、o、u 是母音字母，每個字通常至少有一個。

en: Whenever Lisa comes home, her dog runs to the door and wags its tail happily.
zh: 每當 Lisa 回家，她的狗就跑到門口，開心地搖尾巴。

en: Walnuts, which have hard shells, are rich in healthy fats and make a great snack for students.
zh: 核桃有堅硬的外殼，富含健康的脂肪，是很適合學生的點心。

en: After the operation, Grandpa was moved to a quiet ward where nurses checked on him every hour.
zh: 手術後，爺爺被轉到一間安靜的病房，護理師每小時都來看他。

en: Amy opened her wardrobe and chose a warm sweater from the clothes hanging inside.
zh: Amy 打開衣櫥，從掛在裡面的衣服中挑了一件保暖的毛衣。

en: Before they could search the house, the police had to get a warrant signed by a judge.
zh: 警方必須先取得法官簽署的令狀，才能搜索那棟房子。

en: Luckily, my new phone came with a one-year warranty, so the store repaired the broken screen for free.
zh: 幸好我的新手機有一年保固，所以店家免費修好了破掉的螢幕。

en: Since we were going hiking in the rain, Mom bought me a waterproof jacket that keeps me completely dry.
zh: 因為我們要在雨中健行，媽媽買了一件防水外套給我，讓我全身保持乾爽。

en: After walking for hours in the hot sun, the weary travelers were glad to finally rest under a tree.
zh: 在大太陽下走了好幾個小時後，疲倦的旅人終於能在樹下休息，都很開心。

en: Fishing boats tied up at the wharf, where workers carried boxes of fresh fish onto land every morning.
zh: 漁船停靠在碼頭邊，工人們每天早上在那裡把一箱箱新鮮的魚搬上岸。

en: Scotland is known for whiskey, a strong alcoholic drink made from grain and stored in wooden barrels for years.
zh: 蘇格蘭以威士忌聞名，那是一種用穀物釀製、並在木桶中存放多年的烈酒。

en: Shop owners buy goods at wholesale prices in large amounts and then sell them to customers at higher prices.
zh: 店主以批發價大量購入商品，再以較高的價格賣給顧客。

en: Fresh vegetables, whole grains, and fruit make a wholesome meal that keeps your body strong.
zh: 新鮮蔬菜、全穀物和水果組成一頓有益健康的餐點，讓你的身體保持強壯。

en: After her husband died, the widow lived alone in the small house and was cared for by her neighbors.
zh: 丈夫過世後，那位寡婦獨自住在小房子裡，由鄰居照顧她。

en: Until all the facts were checked, the school decided to withhold the test results from the public.
zh: 在所有事實查核完畢之前，學校決定暫不對外公布測驗結果。

en: This sad poem describes the woes of poor farmers who lost all their crops during years of terrible floods.
zh: 這首哀傷的詩描寫了貧苦農民在連年大水中失去所有作物的悲哀。

en: A woodpecker knocks its head against trees again and again, making holes to find insects hiding under the bark.
zh: 啄木鳥一次又一次地用頭敲擊樹幹，啄出洞來尋找藏在樹皮下的昆蟲。

en: As more women entered the workforce in the twentieth century, the number of working mothers grew quickly.
zh: 二十世紀時，隨著更多女性投入勞動市場，職業婦女的人數迅速增加。

en: For weeks, Ken wrestled with the difficult math problem before he finally found the answer.
zh: Ken 和那道數學難題搏鬥了好幾個星期，才終於找到答案。

en: As people grow older, their skin loses its stretch and wrinkles begin to appear around their eyes.
zh: 隨著年紀增長，人的皮膚失去彈性，眼睛周圍開始出現皺紋。

en: Living far from home, the student yearned for her mother's cooking and the familiar streets of her hometown.
zh: 遠離家鄉的這名學生，渴望吃到媽媽煮的飯菜，也想念家鄉熟悉的街道。

en: Many people practice yoga, stretching their bodies and breathing slowly, to relax their minds and stay flexible.
zh: 許多人練瑜伽，透過伸展身體和緩慢呼吸來放鬆心情、保持柔軟度。

en: For breakfast, Amy enjoys a bowl of yogurt with fresh fruit, which is good for her stomach.
zh: Amy 早餐喜歡吃一碗加新鮮水果的優格，這對她的腸胃很好。

en: A race car zoomed past us at great speed, disappearing around the corner in a few seconds.
zh: 一輛賽車以極快的速度從我們身旁呼嘯而過，幾秒鐘就消失在轉角。
